project.name: notebook
project.description: A solo fork of Zed, the high-performance multiplayer code editor, being repurposed as an academic note-taking and research-paper-writing app for physics graduate students (markdown, LaTeX, Jupyter, audio memos, infinite-canvas whiteboard).

nodes.name: api.rs
nodes.summary: Defines typed HTTP header extractors (CloudflareIpCountryHeader, SystemIdHeader) used by the collab server's Axum request handlers to decode custom headers on incoming requests.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements axum::headers::Header manually for two lightweight typed header wrappers using OnceLock-cached HeaderName instances.

nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: Axum router and handlers for the collab server's telemetry ingestion API, accepting client event/panic reports, verifying a checksum header, and forwarding events to AWS Kinesis for downstream Snowflake analytics ingestion.

nodes.name: extensions.rs
nodes.summary: Axum router and handlers exposing the extension registry HTTP API (listing updates/versions, generating presigned download URLs) plus a background job that periodically syncs extension manifests from a blob store into the database.

nodes.name: auth.rs
nodes.summary: Axum middleware that validates the Authorization header on incoming collab requests by calling the zed.dev cloud API to resolve the access token to a user id, then attaches the authenticated Principal to the request extensions.

nodes.name: db.rs
nodes.summary: Core database access layer for the collab server: defines the Database struct with transaction helpers (per-room and per-project locking, retry-safe transactions) plus the DTOs (Channel, Room, Project, Worktree, ChannelMember, etc.) used to serialize collaboration state to and from the protobuf wire protocol.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses per-entity DashMap-based async mutexes to serialize concurrent transactions on the same room/project, avoiding SQL-level lock contention.

nodes.name: buffer.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the buffer table, representing a shared collaborative text buffer scoped to a channel, with relations to its operations, snapshots, and owning channel.

nodes.name: buffer_operation.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the buffer_operation table, storing individual CRDT operations applied to a buffer, keyed by epoch, lamport timestamp, and replica id.

nodes.name: buffer_snapshot.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the buffer_snapshot table, storing a serialized full-text snapshot of a buffer at a given epoch to bound operation replay cost.

nodes.name: channel.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the channel table, encoding the channel hierarchy as a materialized parent_path string and providing helpers to compute ancestors, root id, and descendant path filters for channel tree queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a slash-delimited parent_path column to represent tree ancestry without recursive queries.

nodes.name: channel_buffer_collaborator.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model tracking which connections are actively collaborating on a channel's shared buffer, including their replica id and connection liveness state.

nodes.name: channel_chat_participant.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model tracking which user connections are currently participating in a channel's chat, linking connection id/server to the owning channel.

nodes.name: channel_member.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for channel membership records (acceptance state and role), including a From impl converting a member row into the protobuf ChannelMember message and a UserToChannel many-to-many link helper.

nodes.name: contact.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the contact table representing a bidirectional user contact relationship (requester/recipient with acceptance and notification flags).

nodes.name: contributor.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model recording that a user has signed the project's CLA (contributor license agreement) with a timestamp.

nodes.name: extension.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the extension table, storing an extension's external id, display name, latest published version, and total download count.

nodes.name: extension_version.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for a specific published extension version, tracking which capabilities it provides (themes, languages, grammars, language servers, debug adapters, etc.) via boolean provides_* columns aggregated by the provides() helper.

nodes.name: follower.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the follower table, recording a leader/follower connection pairing within a room and project for the editor's follow-mode collaboration feature.

nodes.name: language_server.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model tracking a language server instance registered for a project/worktree, including its name, language name, and serialized capabilities.

nodes.name: notification.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for the notification table, storing a recipient user, notification kind, related entity id, serialized content, read state, and response.

nodes.name: notification_kind.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for a lookup table mapping notification kind ids to their string names.

nodes.name: observed_buffer_edits.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model tracking the last buffer operation (epoch, lamport timestamp, replica id) each user has observed, used to compute unseen edits for channel buffers.

nodes.name: CloudflareIpCountryHeader
nodes.summary: Typed Axum header extractor decoding Cloudflare's IP country header into a country code string.

nodes.name: SystemIdHeader
nodes.summary: Typed Axum header extractor decoding a client-supplied system id header.

nodes.name: router
nodes.summary: Builds the Axum router mapping /telemetry/events, /telemetry/crashes, and /telemetry/panics routes to their handlers.

nodes.name: post_events
nodes.summary: HTTP handler that verifies the request checksum, parses the telemetry event batch, converts it to Snowflake rows, and publishes them to a Kinesis stream.

nodes.name: calculate_json_checksum
nodes.summary: Computes a SHA-256 checksum over the request body combined with a server-side seed, used to validate the ZedChecksumHeader.

nodes.name: for_snowflake
nodes.summary: Transforms a batch of raw client telemetry events into flattened SnowflakeRow records enriched with client metadata (app version, OS, country, checksum status).

nodes.name: post_panic
nodes.summary: HTTP handler stub accepting client panic/crash report submissions and returning success.

nodes.name: ZedChecksumHeader
nodes.summary: Typed Axum header extractor decoding the client-supplied request checksum used for telemetry integrity verification.

nodes.name: SnowflakeRow
nodes.summary: Serializable record representing one telemetry event formatted for ingestion into Snowflake via Kinesis, with a write() method that streams a JSON-encoded record to the Kinesis client.

nodes.name: router
nodes.summary: Builds the Axum router for the extension registry HTTP API, wiring update, version-listing, and download endpoints.

nodes.name: get_extension_updates
nodes.summary: Handler returning the latest available extension metadata for a client-supplied set of extension ids, filtered by schema/wasm API version constraints.

nodes.name: get_extension_versions
nodes.summary: Handler returning the full version history for a given extension id.

nodes.name: download_latest_extension
nodes.summary: Handler resolving the latest compatible extension version under given constraints and redirecting to the versioned download handler.

nodes.name: download_extension
nodes.summary: Handler that records a download event and returns a presigned blob-store URL redirect for a specific extension version's archive.

nodes.name: fetch_extensions_from_blob_store_periodically
nodes.summary: Background task spawned on server startup that periodically triggers a full sync of extension manifests from the blob store into the database.

nodes.name: fetch_extensions_from_blob_store
nodes.summary: Lists extension archive objects in the blob store, diffs them against already-known versions in the database, fetches manifests for new versions, and inserts them.

nodes.name: fetch_extension_manifest
nodes.summary: Downloads and parses a single extension's manifest.json from the blob store, constructing a NewExtensionVersion record with parsed semver and publish timestamp.

nodes.name: validate_header
nodes.summary: Axum middleware function that parses the Authorization header, calls the zed.dev cloud API to validate the access token, and injects the resolved Principal::User into request extensions or rejects with 401.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a Database instance, installing SQLx drivers and connecting via sea_orm with fresh per-room/per-project lock maps.

nodes.name: transaction
nodes.summary: Runs a closure inside a database transaction, committing on success and rolling back on error, with test-mode retry simulation via with_transaction/run.

nodes.name: optional_room_transaction
nodes.summary: Runs a transaction while optionally holding a per-room async lock (when the closure's result indicates a room id), serializing concurrent mutations to the same room's state.

nodes.name: project_transaction
nodes.summary: Runs a transaction while holding both the owning room's and the project's async locks, ensuring project mutations are serialized against concurrent room and project transactions.

nodes.name: room_transaction
nodes.summary: Runs a transaction while holding the per-room async lock for the given room id, serializing concurrent mutations to that room.

nodes.name: with_transaction
nodes.summary: Begins a raw SQL transaction and executes the provided closure against a TransactionHandle, returning both the closure's result and the still-open transaction for the caller to commit or roll back.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes an async future, optionally injecting simulated random delay and query failures when test_options are configured, used to fuzz-test transaction retry logic.

nodes.name: db_status_to_proto
nodes.summary: Converts a database git status entry into its protobuf StatusEntry representation, mapping tracked/untracked/ignored/unmerged variants and diff stat fields.

nodes.name: proto_status_to_db
nodes.summary: Converts a protobuf StatusEntry back into the database's git status representation for persistence.

nodes.name: Database
nodes.summary: Central database handle wrapping the sea_orm connection pool alongside per-room and per-project async lock maps used to serialize collaborative transactions.

nodes.name: Channel
nodes.summary: DTO representing a collaboration channel with helpers to build from the SeaORM model, compute its root id, and serialize to protobuf.

nodes.name: RejoinedProject
nodes.summary: DTO capturing the state needed to resume a project session after a client reconnects, including collaborators, worktrees, and repository state, with a to_proto serializer.

nodes.name: ProjectCollaborator
nodes.summary: DTO describing a single collaborator on a shared project (connection id, user id, replica id, host flag, committer identity) with protobuf serialization.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM model for the channel table with tree-navigation helpers (parent_id, is_root, root_id, ancestors) derived from the materialized parent_path column.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM model for a published extension version with a provides() helper that aggregates the provides_* boolean columns into a set of ExtensionProvides capability flags.

nodes.name: project.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity definitions for the `projects` database table, modeling a shared coding project hosted in a collaboration room along with its relations to worktrees, collaborators, and language servers.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM row model for a project record, including its host connection, room, and unregistered timestamp.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Defines SeaORM foreign-key relations from projects to rooms, worktrees, collaborators, project repositories, and language servers.

nodes.name: project_collaborator.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity for the `project_collaborators` table, tracking which connections are collaborating on a shared project and their host/guest role.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM row model representing a single collaborator's connection to a project, including replica id and host flag.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Defines the SeaORM belongs-to relation linking a project collaborator back to its project.

nodes.name: project_repository.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity for the `project_repositories` table, storing git repository metadata (branch, remote, scan id) associated with a shared project.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM row model for a project's git repository, capturing scan state, current branch, and remote URL fields.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Defines the SeaORM relation from a project repository back to its owning project.

nodes.name: project_repository_statuses.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity for `project_repository_statuses`, recording per-file git status (staged/unstaged) within a shared project repository.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM row model for a single file's git status entry within a project repository.

nodes.name: StatusKind
nodes.summary: Enum of git status kinds (e.g. tracked/untracked/conflicted) stored as a SeaORM column type.

nodes.name: room.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity for the `rooms` table, the top-level collaboration session that holds live-share participants, projects, and an optional channel.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM row model for a collaboration room, keyed by id and optional owning channel.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Defines SeaORM relations from a room to its participants, projects, and follower state.

nodes.name: room_participant.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity for `room_participants`, tracking each user's connection, call state, and location within a collaboration room.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM row model for a participant's presence in a room, including calling/answering connection ids and role.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Defines SeaORM relations from a room participant back to its room and user records.

nodes.name: server.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity for the `servers` table, representing a running collab server instance used to track which node owns which connections.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM row model for a single collab server instance record.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Empty SeaORM relation enum placeholder for the server entity.

nodes.summary: Defines SeaORM relations from a user to their room participation, project collaboration, and access tokens.

nodes.name: LocalSettingsKind
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing kinds of local settings files (e.g. settings, tasks, debug configs) stored as a SeaORM column type.

nodes.name: entities.rs
nodes.summary: Thin module declaration file that re-exports the `entities::user` submodule used for authenticated request principals.

nodes.name: user.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the `User` request-extension type used by Axum handlers to carry the authenticated user's database id and admin status.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Lightweight struct carrying an authenticated user's id and staff/admin flags through the Axum request pipeline.

nodes.name: env.rs
nodes.summary: Loads environment variables for the collab server from `.env`/`.env.toml` files and merges them into the process environment at startup.

nodes.name: get_dotenv_vars
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a dotenv-style file into a map of environment variable name/value pairs.

nodes.name: load_dotenv
nodes.summary: Loads the appropriate dotenv file for the current environment and applies its variables to the process.

nodes.name: executor.rs
nodes.summary: Provides an `Executor` abstraction over Tokio's runtime for spawning detached background tasks and sleeping, allowing deterministic executors to be substituted in tests.

nodes.name: Executor
nodes.summary: Enum wrapping either a production Tokio executor or a test/deterministic executor variant used throughout collab.

nodes.name: spawn_detached
nodes.summary: Spawns a future as a detached background task on the configured executor.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the collab server: defines shared `Config`, `AppState`, and `Error` types, wires up the database, RPC, and API modules, and builds cloud storage clients used by the collaboration backend.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Top-level error enum unifying HTTP, internal, and database errors surfaced by the collab server, with conversion into Axum HTTP responses.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Deserializable configuration struct for the collab server, including database URL, HTTP port, and third-party service credentials.

nodes.name: AppState
nodes.summary: Shared application state constructed at server startup, bundling the database handle, config, and cloud service clients passed to Axum route handlers.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the `AppState`, connecting to the database and initializing blob storage and Kinesis clients from config.

nodes.name: build_blob_store_client
nodes.summary: Builds an S3-compatible blob storage client from configuration for storing large collaboration artifacts.

nodes.name: build_kinesis_client
nodes.summary: Builds an AWS Kinesis client from configuration used for streaming server telemetry/events.

nodes.name: rpc.rs
nodes.summary: The core real-time RPC server for collaboration: manages WebSocket connections, rooms, channels, and shared projects, dispatching over 100 message handlers for joining/leaving rooms, sharing projects, buffer sync, channel chat, contacts, and notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Extremely large central dispatcher (over 4000 lines) implementing the collab protocol's message router via a handler-registration pattern (`add_handler`/`add_message_handler`/`add_request_handler`).

nodes.name: Server
nodes.summary: The central collaboration server object holding peer connections, the connection pool, and the registry of RPC message handlers.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Per-connection context passed to RPC handlers, exposing the database, connection pool, user id, and peer for a single client session.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the RPC `Server` and registers every message handler (room, project, channel, contact, and notification operations) against the peer dispatcher.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts background maintenance tasks for the server, such as periodic stale-connection cleanup and metrics reporting.

nodes.name: handle_connection
nodes.summary: Drives a single client's WebSocket connection lifecycle: authentication, registering with the connection pool, dispatching incoming messages, and cleanup on disconnect.

nodes.name: handle_websocket_request
nodes.summary: Axum HTTP handler that upgrades an incoming request to a WebSocket connection and hands it off to `handle_connection`.

nodes.name: join_room
nodes.summary: Handles a client's request to join an existing collaboration room, updating participant state and broadcasting the join to other participants.

nodes.name: share_project
nodes.summary: Handles a host sharing a local project into the current room, registering it in the database for other participants to join.

nodes.name: join_project
nodes.summary: Handles a guest joining a shared project, synchronizing worktree state, buffers, and collaborators to the new participant.

nodes.name: update_buffer
nodes.summary: Handles incoming buffer edit operations from a client and forwards them to other collaborators on the shared project.

nodes.name: create_channel
nodes.summary: Handles creation of a new channel, persisting it and notifying relevant users of the membership update.

nodes.name: send_channel_message
nodes.summary: Handles sending a chat message into a channel, persisting it and broadcasting to subscribed participants.

nodes.name: leave_room_for_session
nodes.summary: Cleans up a disconnecting session's room membership, releasing shared projects and notifying remaining participants.

nodes.name: connection_pool.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks live client connections and their channel subscriptions in memory, providing lookup of which connections belong to a user or are subscribed to a channel for message fan-out.

nodes.name: ConnectionPool
nodes.summary: In-memory registry mapping users and channels to their active WebSocket connections, used by the RPC server to route and broadcast messages.

nodes.name: ChannelPool
nodes.summary: Tracks which connections are subscribed to which channels, supporting subscribe/unsubscribe and notification fan-out.

nodes.name: add_connection
nodes.summary: Registers a new connection for a user, tracking its zed version and admin/staff status in the pool.

nodes.name: remove_connection
nodes.summary: Removes a disconnected connection from the pool and cleans up any per-user tracking that becomes empty.

nodes.name: check_invariants
nodes.summary: Debug-time consistency check verifying the connection pool's internal maps remain in sync with each other.

nodes.name: services.rs
nodes.summary: Thin module declaration file that re-exports the `services::user_service` submodule used to call the external user/cloud service.

nodes.name: user_service.rs
nodes.summary: HTTP client wrapper for querying the external cloud user service (by id, GitHub login, or fuzzy search) and mapping responses to internal user/channel-member types.

nodes.name: UserService
nodes.summary: Trait/struct abstraction for looking up user information, allowing the RPC layer to be decoupled from the concrete cloud implementation.

nodes.name: CloudUserService
nodes.summary: Concrete `UserService` implementation that queries Zed's cloud backend over HTTP for user and channel member data.

nodes.name: send_request
nodes.summary: Sends an authenticated HTTP request to the cloud user service and deserializes the JSON response.

nodes.name: get_users_by_ids
nodes.summary: Fetches user records for a batch of user ids from the cloud user service.

nodes.name: fuzzy_search_users
nodes.summary: Performs a fuzzy name/login search against the cloud user service for contact/invite autocompletion.

nodes.name: search_channel_members
nodes.summary: Searches for potential channel members via the cloud service and maps results into internal channel-member proto types.

nodes.name: _accessibility.rs
nodes.summary: Documentation-only module presenting GPUI's programmatic accessibility guide, explaining how the framework integrates with AccessKit so assistive technologies like screen readers can inspect and interact with the UI.
nodes.languageNotes: The underscore filename prefix and pure //! inner-doc-comment body signal this is a rustdoc guide module included only for the crate's rendered documentation, not runtime code.

nodes.name: _ownership_and_data_flow.rs
nodes.summary: Documentation-only module explaining GPUI's core ownership model, where the top-level App owns all entities and views and mediates their access, subscriptions, and data flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure //! doc-comment module (underscore-prefixed) that documents the entity-ownership design central to GPUI; foundational reading for understanding App/Entity/Context relationships.

nodes.name: action.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Action trait and ActionRegistry that back GPUI's command system, letting keybindings and menus resolve to typed, serializable actions dispatched through the UI element tree.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a type-erased Action trait (as_any) plus a name-keyed registry with build/deprecation/JSON-schema support so actions can be authored declaratively via macros.

nodes.name: app.rs
nodes.summary: The heart of GPUI: defines App/Application, the owner of all entities, windows, globals, and executors, and the effect queue that drives notifications, subscriptions, action dispatch, and platform lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: Nearly 3000 lines built around interior mutability (AppCell/RefCell) and a deferred Effect queue flushed after each update; the App struct alone exposes ~160 methods, making it the central service locator for the whole framework.

nodes.name: arena.rs
nodes.summary: A bump-allocation arena used during element layout/paint to cheaply allocate short-lived objects and reset them en masse each frame, avoiding per-element heap churn.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a chunked bump allocator with ArenaBox smart pointers and manual Drop bookkeeping; validates allocations against the current generation so stale boxes cannot outlive an arena reset.

nodes.name: asset_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Asset trait and Resource keys for asynchronously loaded, cacheable assets (images, SVGs), with an AssetLogger wrapper for load diagnostics.

nodes.name: assets.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the AssetSource abstraction for reading embedded/filesystem asset bytes plus RenderImage and image-id types used by the renderer to hold decoded, multi-frame image data.

nodes.name: bounds_tree.rs
nodes.summary: A bounding-volume hierarchy that assigns draw ordering to overlapping primitives, enabling correct z-ordering and efficient hit/overlap queries during scene construction.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements an AABB tree with leaf insertion that computes max ordering among intersecting nodes; core to how the paint phase resolves stacking order without a global sort.

nodes.name: color.rs
nodes.summary: Core color types (Rgba, Hsla, Background) with blending, gradients, serde/JSON-schema support, and conversions, forming the color foundation for styling and theming across GPUI.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides both Rgba and Hsla with full arithmetic (blend, grayscale, fade_out) and a tagged Background enum supporting solid, linear-gradient, and pattern fills consumed directly by the paint pipeline.

nodes.name: colors.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the default GPUI Colors palette with light/dark appearance variants, exposed as a global so elements can resolve appearance-aware default colors.

nodes.name: element.rs
nodes.summary: Defines GPUI's central Element/IntoElement/Render traits and the AnyElement type-erased wrapper, codifying the request_layout -> prepaint -> paint lifecycle every UI element flows through.
nodes.languageNotes: The Element trait's three-phase drawing contract (request_layout/prepaint/paint) plus the ElementDrawPhase state machine is the extension point every custom widget in the fork's editor UI implements.

nodes.name: executor.rs
nodes.summary: Provides BackgroundExecutor and ForegroundExecutor for spawning async tasks on worker threads or the UI thread, plus deterministic test scheduling, timers, and scoped concurrency.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps a platform dispatcher to give the app single-threaded foreground and multi-threaded background executors, with test-mode helpers (run_until_parked, advance_clock, simulate_random_delay) for deterministic async tests.

nodes.name: geometry.rs
nodes.summary: The comprehensive geometry and units library for GPUI: generic Point/Size/Bounds/Edges/Corners plus Pixels/DevicePixels/Rems length types with arithmetic, conversions, and layout helpers used throughout rendering and layout.
nodes.languageNotes: Over 4000 lines of generic, unit-safe primitives; distinct Pixels/DevicePixels/ScaledPixels/Rems newtypes enforce DPI-correctness at the type level, a key design choice preventing pixel/rem mixups across the layout engine.

nodes.name: gestures.rs
nodes.summary: Defines gesture tuning parameters and the PlatformGestures abstraction (with a null implementation) for recognizing long-press and other higher-level touch gestures.

nodes.name: global.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Global marker trait and ReadGlobal/UpdateGlobal extension traits that give ergonomic access to app-wide singleton state stored in the App.

nodes.name: gpui.rs
nodes.summary: The GPUI crate root that wires together every module and re-exports the public API, and defines the foundational AppContext/VisualContext/BorrowAppContext traits and GpuSpecs shared across the framework.
nodes.languageNotes: Beyond being the module barrel, it declares the AppContext and VisualContext traits that App and Window implement, defining the uniform surface entities use to read/update state and spawn work.

nodes.name: input.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the EntityInputHandler and ElementInputHandler traits that bridge platform IME/text-input events to editable entities, handling text ranges, marked text, and coordinate queries.
nodes.languageNotes: The EntityInputHandler surface (selected/marked ranges, replace_and_mark_text_in_range, bounds_for_range) is exactly what a text editor or LaTeX field in the fork must implement to receive IME and composition input.

nodes.name: inspector.rs
nodes.summary: Defines InspectorElementId, the identifier tying rendered elements to the built-in UI inspector/devtools overlay for picking and examining elements at runtime.

nodes.name: interactive.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the full hierarchy of input event types (key, mouse, scroll, touch, pinch, drag, file-drop) and the PlatformInput enum that GPUI dispatches to interactive elements.
nodes.languageNotes: A large catalog of event structs sharing to_platform_input conversions and click-synthesis logic (ClickEvent); this is the vocabulary of every on_click/on_mouse_down handler wired in the editor UI.

nodes.name: key_dispatch.rs
nodes.summary: Implements DispatchTree, the per-frame tree of focus/keymap context nodes that resolves keystrokes to bindings and actions, and computes focus and dispatch paths for event bubbling.
nodes.languageNotes: DispatchTree rebuilds each frame (with subtree reuse) to map the focus path to context predicates, so keybindings resolve contextually; its bindings_for_input/possible_next_bindings_for_input support multi-key chord matching.

nodes.name: ActionRegistry
nodes.summary: Central registry that stores all registered action types keyed by name and builds, resolves, and reports schemas/deprecations for them.

nodes.name: ActionBuildError
nodes.summary: Error type returned when an action cannot be built from its name or serialized data.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: The application context and owner of all entities, windows, globals, executors, and the effect queue; the primary service surface (~160 methods) through which entities read state, subscribe, dispatch actions, and drive the platform.

nodes.name: Application
nodes.summary: Builder/entry handle that configures platform, assets, and HTTP client then runs the GPUI application main loop.

nodes.name: SystemWindowTabController
nodes.summary: Manages native window tab groups, tracking tab order, visibility, titles, and cross-window merge/move operations.

nodes.name: Effect
nodes.summary: Enum of deferred side effects (notify, emit, refresh, defer, entity-created) queued during an update and flushed afterward to drive observers and rendering.

nodes.name: Arena
nodes.summary: Chunked bump allocator that hands out ArenaBox pointers for frame-scoped allocations and resets all of them at once via clear.

nodes.name: ArenaBox
nodes.summary: Smart-pointer handle into arena-allocated memory that validates its generation before deref to prevent use-after-reset.

nodes.name: BoundsTree
nodes.summary: Bounding-volume hierarchy that inserts primitive bounds and assigns each a draw ordering derived from overlapping siblings, resolving z-order during scene building.

nodes.name: Rgba
nodes.summary: Straight (non-premultiplied) RGBA color with blending, alpha adjustment, serde/JSON-schema support, and conversion to/from Hsla.

nodes.name: Hsla
nodes.summary: Hue-saturation-lightness-alpha color, the primary color type for styling, with named constructors, blending, grayscale, fade, and opacity operations.

nodes.name: Background
nodes.summary: Tagged background fill supporting solid colors, linear gradients, and patterns, consumed directly by the paint pipeline.

nodes.name: Colors
nodes.summary: Default GPUI color palette with light/dark appearance constructors, resolved via a global for appearance-aware element defaults.

nodes.name: Element
nodes.summary: The core trait every UI element implements, defining the request_layout -> prepaint -> paint lifecycle plus layout_as_root for driving an element as a window's root.

nodes.name: AnyElement
nodes.summary: Type-erased boxed element that drives an arbitrary Element through its draw phases, letting containers hold heterogeneous children.

nodes.name: ParentElement
nodes.summary: Trait for elements that accept and lay out children, providing the child/children builder methods used across container widgets.

nodes.name: BackgroundExecutor
nodes.summary: Multi-threaded executor for spawning CPU/IO work off the UI thread, with timers, scoped concurrency, and deterministic test controls (run_until_parked, advance_clock).

nodes.name: ForegroundExecutor
nodes.summary: Single-threaded executor that runs futures on the UI thread so tasks can safely touch App and window state.

nodes.name: Bounds
nodes.summary: Generic origin+size rectangle with a rich API for intersection, union, dilation, containment, corner access, and coordinate mapping used throughout layout and hit-testing.

nodes.name: Pixels
nodes.summary: Logical-pixel newtype with full arithmetic and rounding, distinct from DevicePixels/Rems to enforce DPI-correct unit handling at the type level.

nodes.name: Point
nodes.summary: Generic 2D point with mapping, scaling, min/max, and axis-projection helpers reused for pixels, rems, and abstract coordinates.

nodes.name: Size
nodes.summary: Generic width/height pair with mapping, scaling, and constructors, foundational to layout measurement across the framework.

nodes.name: Length
nodes.summary: Style length value abstracting definite (px/rem/percentage) and auto lengths, bridging author-facing style values to the layout engine.

nodes.name: ClickEvent
nodes.summary: Synthesized click event unifying mouse, keyboard, and touch click sources with modifier, position, and click-count accessors used by on_click handlers.

nodes.name: PlatformInput
nodes.summary: Top-level enum of all raw platform input events (mouse, keyboard, touch) that the window dispatches into the element tree.

nodes.name: ScrollWheelEvent
nodes.summary: Scroll wheel/trackpad event carrying a precise-or-lines ScrollDelta plus modifiers and position for scroll handling.

nodes.name: EntityInputHandler
nodes.summary: Trait an editable entity implements to receive IME/text input, exposing selected and marked ranges, text replacement, and coordinate queries for composition.

nodes.name: DispatchTree
nodes.summary: Per-frame tree of focus and keymap-context nodes that resolves keystrokes to bindings/actions and computes focus and dispatch paths for event routing, with subtree reuse across frames.

nodes.name: flush_effects
nodes.summary: Drains the deferred Effect queue after an update, applying notify/emit/refresh/entity-created effects and releasing dropped entities to keep observers and rendering consistent.

nodes.name: dispatch_global_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches an action to globally registered handlers, walking registered listeners and respecting propagation stops.

nodes.name: open_window
nodes.summary: Creates a new platform window with the given options and root view, registering it in the App's window set.

nodes.name: alloc
nodes.summary: Bump-allocates a value in the arena, growing with a new chunk when needed and returning a generation-checked ArenaBox.

nodes.name: insert_leaf
nodes.summary: Inserts a new leaf into the bounds hierarchy, rebalancing internal nodes and computing the draw ordering from overlapping bounds.

nodes.name: find_max_ordering
nodes.summary: Traverses the tree to find the maximum draw ordering among nodes whose bounds intersect a query rectangle, used to place new primitives above overlapping ones.

nodes.name: prepaint
nodes.summary: Drives the prepaint phase of an element's draw lifecycle within Drawable, computing layout-derived state before the paint phase runs.

nodes.name: request_layout
nodes.summary: Runs an element's request_layout phase, registering its layout requirements with the layout engine and producing a layout id.

nodes.name: dispatch_key
nodes.summary: Matches a keystroke against the dispatch tree's bindings along the focus path, returning matched actions or pending state for multi-key chords.

nodes.name: reuse_subtree
nodes.summary: Reuses a previously built dispatch subtree across frames to avoid rebuilding unchanged portions of the focus/context tree.

nodes.name: available_actions
nodes.summary: Collects all actions available at the current focus location by walking the dispatch path and its registered action listeners.

nodes.name: from_anchor_and_size
nodes.summary: Constructs Bounds positioned relative to an anchor corner and a size, used to place popovers and floating elements.

nodes.name: try_from
nodes.summary: Parses a color string (hex/rgb forms) into an Rgba, handling the various accepted textual color formats.

nodes.name: coalesce
nodes.summary: Merges consecutive scroll-wheel events into one, combining deltas to reduce redundant scroll handling.

nodes.name: AppContext
nodes.summary: The core trait implemented by App and Window giving entities a uniform way to create, read, update, and spawn work against application state.

nodes.name: VisualContext
nodes.summary: Extension of AppContext available while a window is present, adding view-creation and focus operations for rendering contexts.

nodes.name: UpdateGlobal
nodes.summary: Extension trait giving ergonomic mutable access to app-wide global singleton state.

nodes.name: keymap.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Keymap that stores keybindings and resolves keystroke sequences to actions, including multi-key partial-match handling used by GPUI's input dispatch.
nodes.languageNotes: Versioned keymap (KeymapVersion) lets consumers cheaply detect when bindings changed and invalidate caches.

nodes.name: Keymap
nodes.summary: Central keybinding store that indexes bindings and matches keystroke sequences against a context stack, returning fully or partially matched bindings.

nodes.name: bindings_for_input
nodes.summary: Resolves a keystroke sequence against the active context stack, returning matched bindings plus any pending prefixes that could still complete a multi-key chord.

nodes.name: bindings_for_action
nodes.summary: Returns the keybindings that would trigger a given action, honoring context predicates so callers can display accurate shortcut hints.

nodes.name: possible_next_bindings_for_input
nodes.summary: Computes which bindings could still match if more keystrokes arrive, enabling pending multi-key chord feedback.

nodes.name: path_builder.rs
nodes.summary: Builder API for constructing 2D vector paths (lines, beziers, arcs, polygons) and tessellating them into fill or stroke geometry for the GPU renderer.
nodes.languageNotes: Relevant to the fork's planned infinite-canvas whiteboard: this is the primitive for drawing arbitrary vector strokes and shapes.

nodes.name: PathBuilder
nodes.summary: Fluent builder that accumulates path commands and tessellates them into renderable geometry, supporting both fill and dashed/solid stroke styles.

nodes.name: tessellate_stroke
nodes.summary: Converts an accumulated path into stroke geometry with the configured width and dash pattern for GPU rendering.

nodes.name: build_path
nodes.summary: Finalizes the builder into a renderable Path primitive, dispatching to fill or stroke tessellation based on style.

nodes.name: arc_to
nodes.summary: Appends an arc segment to the current path from the current point to a target with given radius and sweep.

nodes.name: platform.rs
nodes.summary: Central platform-abstraction layer defining the Platform, PlatformWindow, PlatformDispatcher, PlatformTextSystem, and PlatformAtlas traits that OS-specific backends implement, plus the shared window/clipboard/image value types.
nodes.languageNotes: This is the seam where GPUI decouples the app from macOS/Linux/Windows backends; every OS integration for the notebook fork routes through these traits.

nodes.name: Platform
nodes.summary: The core platform trait (63 methods) abstracting the app lifecycle, windows, displays, clipboard, dispatchers, and OS services behind a backend-agnostic interface.

nodes.name: PlatformWindow
nodes.summary: Trait (84 methods) abstracting a native OS window: bounds, decorations, input, appearance, callbacks, and rendering surface access.

nodes.name: PlatformDispatcher
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the OS task dispatcher used to schedule work on foreground and background threads.

nodes.name: PlatformTextSystem
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting OS font loading, shaping, and glyph rasterization consumed by the higher-level text system.

nodes.name: PlatformAtlas
nodes.summary: Trait for the GPU texture atlas that caches rasterized glyphs and sprites for the renderer.

nodes.name: PlatformInputHandler
nodes.summary: Bridges OS IME/text-input events into the app, translating platform input handler callbacks into GPUI selection and replacement operations.

nodes.name: InputHandler
nodes.summary: Trait that focused elements implement to receive IME text input, selection, and marked-text operations.

nodes.name: WindowOptions
nodes.summary: Configuration struct describing a window's initial bounds, titlebar, kind, appearance, and decoration options at creation time.

nodes.name: ClipboardItem
nodes.summary: Represents clipboard contents as a list of typed entries (text or images) with helpers for reading and constructing them.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: In-memory image value carrying encoded bytes and format, with helpers for decoding and identifying image data across the platform layer.

nodes.name: platform_scheduler.rs
nodes.summary: Provides PlatformScheduler, a dispatcher/executor wiring foreground and background task execution and timers on top of the platform dispatcher.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges GPUI's executor model to the OS dispatcher; central to how async work (e.g. Jupyter REPL, audio) is scheduled off the UI thread.

nodes.name: PlatformScheduler
nodes.summary: Owns foreground and background executors and blocking/timer primitives layered over the platform dispatcher.

nodes.name: block
nodes.summary: Blocks the current thread while draining the dispatcher until a future completes, used to run async work synchronously where required.

nodes.name: prelude.rs
nodes.summary: Convenience prelude re-exporting the traits and types most commonly needed when building GPUI applications, so consumers import one module instead of many.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `as _` re-exports to bring trait methods into scope without name collisions.

nodes.name: profiler.rs
nodes.summary: In-process profiling infrastructure that records per-task and per-thread timing, aggregates frame statistics, and serializes them for analysis.
nodes.languageNotes: Separates live collection (ProfilingCollector) from serializable snapshots, allowing timings to be exported without holding runtime locks.

nodes.name: ProfilingCollector
nodes.summary: Collects per-thread task timings at runtime, tracking active timings and producing aggregate statistics.

nodes.name: ThreadTimings
nodes.summary: Aggregated timing statistics for a single thread, supporting delta computation between samples.

nodes.name: FrameTimingCollector
nodes.summary: Records per-frame timing samples to measure render loop performance over time.

nodes.name: queue.rs
nodes.summary: Lock-light priority MPSC channel with sender/receiver halves and blocking/spinning variants used to dispatch prioritized work between threads.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides spin_* fast paths alongside blocking recv, trading CPU for latency under contention.

nodes.name: PriorityQueueSender
nodes.summary: Sending half of the priority queue, enqueuing items at a chosen priority with blocking and spinning send variants.

nodes.name: PriorityQueueReceiver
nodes.summary: Receiving half of the priority queue, popping the highest-priority item with blocking, try, and spin variants plus iterators.

nodes.name: pop_inner
nodes.summary: Core dequeue routine that selects and removes the next item honoring priority ordering across the internal queues.

nodes.name: scene.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the render Scene and its GPU primitive types (quads, sprites, shadows, underlines, paths) that the painter accumulates and batches for the renderer to draw.
nodes.languageNotes: Primitives are POD structs laid out for GPU consumption; PrimitiveBatch groups same-kind primitives to minimize draw calls.

nodes.name: Scene
nodes.summary: Accumulates paint operations and primitives for a frame, then batches them by kind for efficient GPU submission.

nodes.name: Primitive
nodes.summary: Enum over all drawable primitive kinds (quad, sprite, shadow, path, etc.) with helpers to query bounds and ordering.

nodes.name: TransformationMatrix
nodes.summary: 2D affine transform used to position and scale primitives, with composition and application helpers.

nodes.name: shared_uri.rs
nodes.summary: Thin newtype wrapping a shared, reference-counted URI string used to identify remote or local resources cheaply across the app.

nodes.name: style.rs
nodes.summary: Core styling model defining Style, TextStyle, HighlightStyle, fills, shadows, and the flexbox/grid layout enums that drive both layout and painting.
nodes.languageNotes: Refineable-based style model lets styles be layered and overridden; TextStyle/HighlightStyle underpin the fork's markdown and LaTeX rendering.

nodes.name: Style
nodes.summary: The comprehensive style struct combining layout (flex/grid), box model, background, and text properties applied to an element.

nodes.name: TextStyle
nodes.summary: Describes font, size, color, weight, and decoration for rendered text, feeding the text system's shaping and painting.

nodes.name: HighlightStyle
nodes.summary: Overlayable text highlight attributes (color, weight, style, underline) used for syntax highlighting and inline emphasis.

nodes.name: styled.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Styled trait, a large fluent-builder API of ~114 chainable methods (padding, margin, flex, color, etc.) that elements use to declare Tailwind-like styles.
nodes.languageNotes: The Styled trait is GPUI's Tailwind-inspired styling DSL; each method refines the element's Style, enabling ergonomic UI declaration.

nodes.name: Styled
nodes.summary: Fluent trait providing chainable styling methods that mutate an element's underlying Style, the ergonomic surface for declaring layout and appearance.

nodes.name: subscription.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SubscriberSet and Subscription, the RAII-based observer registry backing GPUI's event emission and observation across entities.
nodes.languageNotes: Subscriptions are RAII guards: dropping one removes the observer, while detach() keeps it alive for the app's lifetime.

nodes.name: SubscriberSet
nodes.summary: Registry of keyed subscribers supporting insert, remove, and safe retain-based iteration for firing callbacks without borrow conflicts.

nodes.name: Subscription
nodes.summary: RAII handle that removes its subscriber when dropped, with detach() and join() for lifetime and composition control.

nodes.name: retain
nodes.summary: Iterates subscribers, invoking a callback and dropping those that request removal, while safely handling reentrant modification.

nodes.name: svg_renderer.rs
nodes.summary: Rasterizes SVG assets into alpha masks and pixmaps via resvg, with bundled-font loading and emoji font selection for icon rendering.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles generic font-family fixups and emoji font selection so bundled SVG icons render consistently across platforms.

nodes.name: SvgRenderer
nodes.summary: Renders SVG parameters into alpha masks or single-frame pixmaps for use as cached sprites in the atlas.

nodes.name: render_alpha_mask
nodes.summary: Rasterizes an SVG into a single-channel alpha mask at the requested size for monochrome icon rendering.

nodes.name: render_pixmap
nodes.summary: Parses and rasterizes an SVG into a full-color pixmap using resvg with the configured font database.

nodes.name: tab_stop.rs
nodes.summary: Manages tab-order navigation: a TabStopMap records focusable stops in grouped tree order and computes next/prev focus targets for keyboard traversal.
nodes.languageNotes: Groups form a tree so Tab traversal can descend and ascend nested focus scopes; supports replaying recorded operations.

nodes.name: TabStopMap
nodes.summary: Records focusable tab stops within nested groups and computes forward/backward focus navigation targets.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Computes the next tab stop after the current focus, descending into and ascending out of nested groups as needed.

nodes.name: prev
nodes.summary: Computes the previous tab stop before the current focus for reverse (Shift+Tab) traversal.

nodes.name: taffy.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps the Taffy flexbox/grid layout engine, translating GPUI styles into Taffy nodes and computing layout with element-provided measure functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges GPUI's Style to Taffy's model and supplies measure closures for leaf content (text, images), the core of the layout pass.

nodes.name: TaffyLayoutEngine
nodes.summary: Owns the Taffy layout tree, requests layout nodes from GPUI styles, and computes resolved bounds using measure callbacks.

nodes.name: test.rs
nodes.summary: Test-support utilities for GPUI, including deterministic seeded proptest configuration, repeatable test-runner helpers, and an Observation primitive.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives reproducible seeds so property tests and randomized executor scheduling can be replayed deterministically.

nodes.name: run_test
nodes.summary: Runs a test closure across multiple deterministic seeds, retrying with recorded seeds to reproduce failures.

nodes.name: calculate_seeds
nodes.summary: Derives the set of seeds to run for a test from environment configuration and iteration count.

nodes.name: text_system.rs
nodes.summary: High-level text system layering font management, shaping, line layout/wrapping, and glyph caching on top of the platform text backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Splits app-global TextSystem from per-window WindowTextSystem; central to rendering the fork's markdown, LaTeX, and code text.

nodes.name: TextSystem
nodes.summary: App-global text system managing font selection, metrics, shaping, and a wrapper cache over the platform text backend.

nodes.name: WindowTextSystem
nodes.summary: Per-window text layer that shapes and lays out lines using the global text system, producing rendered line geometry.

nodes.name: FontMetrics
nodes.summary: Font metric values (ascent, descent, line height, cap height, etc.) with conversion helpers used for precise text layout.

nodes.name: Font
nodes.summary: Value describing a requested font by family, weight, style, and features, resolved to a FontId by the text system.

nodes.name: util.rs
nodes.summary: Small cross-cutting utilities: the FluentBuilder trait for conditional builder chaining, future timeout extensions, and device-pixel rounding helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: FluentBuilder underpins the ergonomic when()/map() chaining used throughout GPUI's element and style builders.

nodes.name: FluentBuilder
nodes.summary: Trait adding when/when_some/map combinators so any builder can apply conditional transformations fluently.

nodes.name: view.rs
nodes.summary: Defines View and AnyView, the type-erased handles wrapping a rendered entity as an Element, plus the ViewElement that drives their layout/prepaint/paint lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: AnyView erases the concrete render type so heterogeneous views compose; ViewElement caches layout across frames for reuse.

nodes.name: AnyView
nodes.summary: Type-erased view handle that can be downcast, downgraded to a weak handle, and rendered as an element.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Typed handle to a rendered entity implementing Render, convertible into an element for composition.

nodes.name: ViewElement
nodes.summary: Element adapter that runs a view's request_layout/prepaint/paint lifecycle and caches results for frame reuse.

nodes.name: prepaint
nodes.summary: Prepaint phase for a view element: positions content and prepares hitboxes before the paint pass.

nodes.name: paint
nodes.summary: Paint phase for a view element, emitting the view's primitives into the scene.

nodes.name: window.rs
nodes.summary: The heart of GPUI's per-window runtime: the Window struct orchestrates the draw loop, layout/prepaint/paint passes, focus and hitbox management, input dispatch, element state, and the primitive-painting API.
nodes.languageNotes: At 6500+ lines the Window is GPUI's central runtime object; the draw() pipeline and paint_* helpers are the main extension points for the fork's custom rendering (whiteboard, LaTeX).

nodes.name: Window
nodes.summary: Central per-window runtime (229 methods) driving the draw loop, layout and paint phases, focus, input dispatch, element state, and primitive painting.

nodes.name: FocusHandle
nodes.summary: Reference-counted handle identifying a focusable element, supporting focus/blur queries and containment checks.

nodes.name: WindowInvalidator
nodes.summary: Tracks dirty state and schedules redraws, coordinating when the window must repaint or relayout.

nodes.name: Frame
nodes.summary: Holds the mutable state accumulated during a single draw pass (scene, hitboxes, element states) for reuse and diffing.

nodes.name: ElementId
nodes.summary: Stable identity for elements across frames, enabling element-state caching and hitbox continuity.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Runs a full frame: layout, prepaint, and paint of the root element, producing the scene submitted to the GPU.

nodes.name: dispatch_event
nodes.summary: Routes a platform input event through hitbox testing, focus, and the dispatch tree to the appropriate handlers and actions.

nodes.name: with_element_state

nodes.name: clipboard.rs
nodes.summary: Windows clipboard integration for GPUI: reads and writes text, images, and file lists to/from the system clipboard via the Win32 clipboard API.

nodes.name: ClipboardGuard
nodes.summary: RAII guard that opens the Win32 clipboard on construction and closes it on drop, ensuring safe paired open/close calls.

nodes.name: destination_list.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the Windows taskbar jump list, adding dock menu items and recent-folder shortcuts via shell APIs.

nodes.name: JumpList
nodes.summary: Wraps the Windows ICustomDestinationList COM interface to build and commit the application's taskbar jump list.

nodes.name: direct_manipulation.rs
nodes.summary: Integrates Windows Direct Manipulation for touch/trackpad gesture handling (pan, zoom), translating viewport update events into GPUI input events.

nodes.name: DirectManipulationHandler
nodes.summary: Manages the lifecycle of a Direct Manipulation manager bound to a window, handling pointer hit tests and draining gesture events.

nodes.name: DirectManipulationEventHandler
nodes.summary: COM callback implementation invoked by Windows on viewport status/content changes, translating them into GPUI-consumable gesture events.

nodes.name: direct_write.rs
nodes.summary: Text shaping and font rendering backend for Windows built on DirectWrite: font enumeration, glyph layout, rasterization, and font-fallback resolution feeding GPUI's text system.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy COM interop with DirectWrite interfaces (IDWriteTextRenderer, IDWriteGlyphRunAnalysis) to bridge Windows font shaping into GPUI's abstract text system.

nodes.name: DirectWriteTextSystem
nodes.summary: Implements GPUI's platform text-system trait using DirectWrite: font loading, layout, glyph rasterization, and typographic metrics.

nodes.name: DirectWriteState
nodes.summary: Internal mutable state for the DirectWrite text system: loaded fonts, font collection, and caches used during layout and rasterization.

nodes.name: ClusterAnalyzer
nodes.summary: Analyzes glyph clusters produced by DirectWrite to map between UTF-8/UTF-16 string indices and glyph positions.

nodes.name: directx_atlas.rs
nodes.summary: Manages GPU texture atlases on DirectX, packing rasterized glyphs and sprites into shared textures with reference counting and device-lost recovery.

nodes.name: DirectXAtlas
nodes.summary: Implements GPUI's sprite-atlas trait for DirectX, allocating and uploading sprite textures and handling GPU device-lost recovery.

nodes.name: DirectXAtlasTexture
nodes.summary: Represents a single GPU atlas texture, tracking free-space allocation and reference counts for packed sprites.

nodes.name: directx_devices.rs
nodes.summary: Initializes and manages the DirectX 12 device, adapter, and DXGI factory used by the renderer, including device-lost detection and recovery.

nodes.name: DirectXDevices
nodes.summary: Holds the DirectX device, adapter, and DXGI factory handles, with logic to detect and recover from a lost GPU device.

nodes.name: directx_renderer.rs
nodes.summary: Core DirectX 12 rendering pipeline for GPUI on Windows: draws quads, shadows, paths, sprites, and surfaces each frame, manages swap chain presentation via DirectComposition, and handles GPU pipeline state.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a multi-pass rendering pipeline (shadows, quads, paths via an intermediate MSAA texture, sprites, surfaces) with explicit DirectX 12 pipeline state objects and blend states per draw type.

nodes.name: DirectXRenderer
nodes.summary: Top-level renderer coordinating the per-frame draw sequence, resource creation, swap-chain presentation, and device-lost recovery for a window.

nodes.name: DirectXResources
nodes.summary: Holds render targets, intermediate textures, and buffers created for a window's render surface, recreated on resize or device loss.

nodes.name: DirectXRenderPipelines
nodes.summary: Compiles and stores the set of DirectX pipeline state objects (vertex/fragment shaders, blend states) for each draw type.

nodes.name: DirectComposition
nodes.summary: Wraps DirectComposition device and target setup used to present the swap chain into a window surface.

nodes.name: dispatcher.rs
nodes.summary: Implements GPUI's platform dispatcher trait for Windows, scheduling work on the main thread and a thread pool, including delayed/timer-based dispatch with increased timer resolution.

nodes.name: WindowsDispatcher
nodes.summary: Dispatches runnables to the main thread or a background thread pool on Windows, including delayed dispatch via Win32 timers.

nodes.name: display.rs
nodes.summary: Implements GPUI's platform display trait for Windows, enumerating monitors and exposing their bounds, scale factor, and UUID.

nodes.name: WindowsDisplay
nodes.summary: Represents a single monitor on Windows, providing bounds, scale factor, and stable UUID derived from the monitor handle.

nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: Central Win32 window-message handler translating WM_* messages (mouse, keyboard, IME, resize, DPI, theme change, device loss) into GPUI platform input and window events.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large dispatch surface covering dozens of individual WM_* message handlers, including IME composition tracking and non-client hit testing.

nodes.name: ImeContext
nodes.summary: Tracks IME composition state (candidate text, cursor position) needed to correctly render and position input-method-editor UI on Windows.

nodes.name: gpui_windows.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root module that declares and re-exports the Windows platform backend's submodules (clipboard, DirectX rendering, DirectWrite text, window management, input dispatch, etc.).

nodes.name: keyboard.rs
nodes.summary: Maps Windows keyboard layouts and virtual key codes to GPUI keystrokes, handling shifted-key generation and layout change detection.

nodes.name: WindowsKeyboardMapper
nodes.summary: Translates virtual key codes and scan codes into GPUI key names given the active Windows keyboard layout, handling shifted-character resolution.

nodes.name: WindowsKeyboardLayout
nodes.summary: Represents the active Windows keyboard layout identifier and name, used for key-equivalent mapping.

nodes.name: platform.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level implementation of GPUI's Platform trait for Windows, wiring together window creation, menus, clipboard, credentials, URL handling, dialogs, and the OS run loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as the composition root for the Windows backend, implementing the full cross-platform Platform trait surface (~80+ methods) by delegating to the other gpui_windows modules.

nodes.name: WindowsPlatform
nodes.summary: Concrete Windows implementation of GPUI's Platform trait, providing window/display management, menus, clipboard, credentials, and the application run loop.

nodes.name: WindowsPlatformState
nodes.summary: Mutable shared state for the Windows platform backend, including open windows, callbacks, and menu configuration.

nodes.name: system_settings.rs
nodes.summary: Reads Windows system settings such as mouse-wheel scroll amount (lines vs. characters) needed to correctly interpret scroll input.

nodes.name: WindowsSystemSettings
nodes.summary: Caches Windows system settings relevant to input handling, refreshed on system settings-changed notifications.

nodes.name: util.rs
nodes.summary: Grab-bag of Windows platform utility functions: word/bit extraction from WPARAM/LPARAM, DWM dark-mode configuration, cursor loading, and system appearance detection.

nodes.name: vsync.rs
nodes.summary: Provides frame-pacing by waiting for the DWM vertical sync interval, used to throttle rendering to the display's refresh rate.

nodes.name: VSyncProvider
nodes.summary: Waits on the DWM composition interval to synchronize the render loop with the monitor's refresh rate.

nodes.name: window.rs
nodes.summary: Implements GPUI's platform Window trait for Windows: window creation, sizing/fullscreen/composition attributes, drag-and-drop, accessibility (A11y) tree, and the window procedure callback.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines low-level Win32 window management with UI Automation (A11y) tree support and OLE drag-and-drop handling in a single large module.

nodes.name: WindowsWindow
nodes.summary: Concrete Windows implementation of GPUI's Window trait: bounds, appearance, input handling, drawing, and lifecycle callbacks for a single native window.

nodes.name: WindowsWindowState
nodes.summary: Mutable per-window state (bounds, fullscreen/maximized flags, placement) tracked alongside the native HWND.

nodes.name: WindowsDragDropHandler
nodes.summary: COM IDropTarget implementation handling OLE drag-and-drop enter/over/leave/drop events for a window.

nodes.name: A11yState
nodes.summary: Holds accessibility tree state and handlers used to expose the window's UI to Windows UI Automation.

nodes.name: wrapper.rs
nodes.summary: Provides small safe wrapper types (SafeHwnd, SafeCursor) around raw Windows handles to allow them to be sent across threads and dereferenced safely.

nodes.name: SafeHwnd
nodes.summary: Thread-safe wrapper around a raw Win32 HWND handle, implementing Deref for ergonomic access.

nodes.name: SafeCursor
nodes.summary: Thread-safe wrapper around a raw Win32 cursor handle (HCURSOR), implementing Deref for ergonomic access.

nodes.name: change_list.rs
nodes.summary: Implements vim's change-list navigation (g; and g,) tracking cursor positions of recent edits, including registration of the change-list movement commands and pushing new positions after edits.

nodes.name: move_to_change
nodes.summary: Moves the cursor to the next or previous position recorded in the buffer's change list, honoring a repeat count.

nodes.name: push_to_change_list
nodes.summary: Records the current selection positions into the editor's change list after an edit, deduplicating against the most recent entry.

nodes.name: command.rs
nodes.summary: Implements vim's ex command-line (`:`) parsing and execution, including command name matching/abbreviation, range parsing, substitute/global commands, marks, options, and shell command integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Large command-dispatch module using string matching against abbreviated vim command names plus a hand-rolled range/position parser for ex-command addressing (e.g. `%`, `.`, `'<,'>`).

nodes.name: possible_commands
nodes.summary: Enumerates candidate ex-command matches for a given input prefix, used for command completion.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers all built-in ex commands (write, quit, substitute, global, marks, etc.) and their action handlers on the editor.

nodes.name: generate_filename_completions
nodes.summary: Produces filesystem-based completion candidates for ex commands that take file paths.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a raw ex command-line string into a structured command range and command name.

nodes.name: parse_range
nodes.summary: Parses vim ex-command address ranges such as line numbers, marks, and the `%` whole-buffer range.

nodes.name: generate_commands
nodes.summary: Builds the static table of supported ex commands with their aliases, argument parsers, and execution callbacks.

nodes.name: command_interceptor
nodes.summary: Intercepts raw command-line input to detect and dispatch matching ex commands before falling through to default handling.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes a parsed OnMatchingLines (`:g`/`:v`) global command across matching buffer lines.

nodes.name: shell_command_motion
nodes.summary: Runs an external shell command and filters/inserts its output over a motion-defined range.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes a ShellExec ex command, piping buffer content through an external shell command.

nodes.name: VimOption
nodes.summary: Represents a `:set`-style vim option with its name, aliases, and value handling.

nodes.name: CommandRange
nodes.summary: Represents a parsed ex-command address range (line numbers, marks, or patterns) used to scope command execution.

nodes.name: OnMatchingLines
nodes.summary: Represents a parsed `:global`/`:vglobal` command with its pattern and nested action to run on matching lines.

nodes.name: ShellExec
nodes.summary: Represents a parsed `:!`-style shell command with its range and command text.

nodes.name: digraph.rs
nodes.summary: Implements vim digraph input (Ctrl-K sequences and literal character entry) for typing special/Unicode characters via two-letter mnemonics.

nodes.name: lookup_digraph
nodes.summary: Looks up the Unicode character corresponding to a two-character digraph mnemonic.

nodes.name: insert_digraph
nodes.summary: Inserts the resolved digraph character at the cursor after digraph entry mode completes.

nodes.name: handle_literal_keystroke
nodes.summary: Handles a single keystroke while collecting a literal character code sequence (Ctrl-V input).

nodes.name: handle_literal_input
nodes.summary: Parses accumulated literal input digits (decimal, hex, octal, unicode) into the target character to insert.

nodes.name: helix.rs
nodes.summary: Implements Helix-editor-style modal editing bindings layered on top of vim mode, including selection-first motions, jump-label navigation, and Helix-specific yank/replace/substitute behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Large module porting Helix's selection-then-action editing model onto vim's Object/Motion abstractions from object.rs.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers Helix-mode actions and keybindings such as motions, selection extension, and jump navigation.

nodes.name: helix_select_motion
nodes.summary: Extends the current selection using a motion in Helix's select mode.

nodes.name: helix_move_cursor
nodes.summary: Moves the cursor and updates selections following Helix's selection-first movement semantics for a given motion.

nodes.name: helix_yank
nodes.summary: Yanks the current Helix selections into the active register.

nodes.name: helix_replace
nodes.summary: Replaces the characters within each Helix selection with a typed replacement character.

nodes.name: helix_select_lines
nodes.summary: Expands the current selections to cover whole lines, Helix's `x` line-select behavior.

nodes.name: helix_jump_to_word
nodes.summary: Initiates Helix's jump-label word navigation mode, overlaying labels on visible words.

nodes.name: build_helix_jump_ui_data
nodes.summary: Builds the on-screen jump label overlay data (positions and label text) for visible jump candidates.

nodes.name: collect_jump_candidates
nodes.summary: Collects candidate jump targets (word start positions) visible in the current viewport for label assignment.

nodes.name: fit_proportional_jump_label
nodes.summary: Computes label placement adjustments for jump labels rendered with a proportional font.

nodes.name: indent.rs
nodes.summary: Implements vim's indent/outdent operators (`>`/`<`) for motions and text objects, applying indentation shifts to buffer ranges.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers the indent and outdent operator actions for motions and text objects.

nodes.name: indent_motion
nodes.summary: Applies indent or outdent to the buffer range spanned by a motion.

nodes.name: indent_object
nodes.summary: Applies indent or outdent to the buffer range spanned by a text object.

nodes.name: insert.rs
nodes.summary: Implements transitions into and out of vim insert mode, including returning to normal mode and surround-on-insert helpers.

nodes.name: normal_before
nodes.summary: Handles the Escape-from-insert-mode transition back to normal mode, adjusting cursor position and repeat state.

nodes.name: insert_around
nodes.summary: Wraps newly inserted text with surrounding characters as part of a surround-on-insert action.

nodes.name: mode_indicator.rs
nodes.summary: Renders the vim mode indicator UI element shown in the status bar (e.g. NORMAL, INSERT, VISUAL) reflecting the current editor mode and pending operator.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the ModeIndicator view, subscribing to vim mode-change events for the active workspace.

nodes.name: current_operators_description
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable description of any pending vim operator (e.g. a partially-entered `d` or `c` command).

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the mode indicator label element reflecting the current vim mode and operator state.

nodes.name: ModeIndicator
nodes.summary: GPUI view struct backing the status bar vim mode indicator.

nodes.name: motion.rs
nodes.summary: Defines vim's motion command set (word/line/paragraph/sentence/bracket/search motions) and the core logic for computing cursor movement ranges given a Motion and repeat count.
nodes.languageNotes: Central motion engine: the `Motion` enum plus `move_point`/`range` dispatch every vim motion (w, e, b, f, t, %, {, }, etc.) to dedicated range/movement functions.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers all built-in motion actions and their keybinding-triggered handlers.

nodes.name: move_point
nodes.summary: Core dispatch function computing the new cursor DisplayPoint for a given Motion variant, count, and current selection goal.

nodes.name: range
nodes.summary: Computes the buffer range spanned by a motion for use by operators like delete/change/yank.

nodes.name: next_word_start
nodes.summary: Computes the position of the start of the next word from the given point, implementing vim's `w` motion.

nodes.name: previous_word_start
nodes.summary: Computes the position of the start of the previous word, implementing vim's `b` motion.

nodes.name: sentence_forwards
nodes.summary: Computes the next sentence boundary position, implementing vim's `)` motion.

nodes.name: find_matching_bracket_text_based
nodes.summary: Finds the matching bracket for the character under the cursor using text-based scanning (fallback when syntax info is unavailable), implementing vim's `%` motion.

nodes.name: matching
nodes.summary: Resolves the matching-bracket motion, preferring syntax-tree-based matching with text-based fallback.

nodes.name: sneak
nodes.summary: Implements the 'sneak' two-character forward search motion plugin behavior.

nodes.name: section_motion
nodes.summary: Computes movement to the next/previous code section boundary (e.g. top-level items) for section motions.

nodes.name: Motion
nodes.summary: Enum representing every supported vim motion variant (word, line, search, bracket, etc.) consumed by move_point and range.

nodes.name: MotionKind
nodes.summary: Classifies a motion as exclusive or inclusive/linewise, determining how its range is applied by operators.

nodes.name: normal.rs
nodes.summary: Implements vim normal-mode operator actions (insert transitions, join lines, yank line, comment toggling, replace) and their registration.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers normal-mode actions such as insert-mode entry points, line joining, yanking, and comment toggling.

nodes.name: normal_motion
nodes.summary: Dispatches a motion invoked while in normal mode, updating cursor/selection and jump list as needed.

nodes.name: normal_object
nodes.summary: Dispatches a text-object selection invoked while in normal mode with a pending operator.

nodes.name: insert_line_above
nodes.summary: Inserts a new line above the cursor and enters insert mode, implementing vim's `O` command.

nodes.name: insert_line_below
nodes.summary: Inserts a new line below the cursor and enters insert mode, implementing vim's `o` command.

nodes.name: toggle_comments
nodes.summary: Toggles line comments over the given motion/selection range.

nodes.name: normal_replace
nodes.summary: Replaces the character(s) at the cursor with a typed character, implementing vim's `r` command.

nodes.name: object.rs
nodes.summary: Implements vim text objects (word, sentence, paragraph, bracket pairs, HTML tags, quotes, indent blocks) used by operators to select inner/around ranges.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the `Object` enum and its `range`/`expand_selection` logic that other modules (helix.rs, normal.rs) depend on for iw/aw/i(/a( style selections.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers text-object actions (inner/around word, sentence, paragraph, bracket, tag, quote) on the editor.

nodes.name: range
nodes.summary: Computes the buffer range spanned by a given text object relative to a selection, dispatching to the object-specific range functions.

nodes.name: in_word
nodes.summary: Computes the inner-word range (`iw`) around a point.

nodes.name: surrounding_html_tag
nodes.summary: Finds the innermost enclosing HTML/XML tag pair around a point for tag text objects (`it`/`at`).

nodes.name: argument
nodes.summary: Computes the function-argument text object range, used for `ia`/`aa`-style argument selection.

nodes.name: sentence
nodes.summary: Computes the sentence text object range around a point.

nodes.name: paragraph
nodes.summary: Computes the paragraph text object range around a point.

nodes.name: surrounding_markers
nodes.summary: Finds the enclosing pair of surround markers (brackets or quote characters) around a point for bracket/quote text objects.

nodes.name: Object
nodes.summary: Enum representing every supported vim text object variant (word, sentence, paragraph, tag, bracket, quote, argument, indent).

nodes.name: replace.rs
nodes.summary: Implements multi-cursor replace-mode character overwriting, undo-aware replace tracking, and the exchange (swap-text) operator.

nodes.name: multi_replace
nodes.summary: Overwrites characters at each cursor with typed input while in vim replace mode (R).

nodes.name: undo_replace
nodes.summary: Restores previously overwritten characters when backspacing during replace mode.

nodes.name: exchange_motion
nodes.summary: Marks or performs an exchange (text swap) operation over a motion-defined range.

nodes.name: exchange_impl
nodes.summary: Performs the actual text swap between two marked exchange ranges.

nodes.name: rewrap.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the vim rewrap operator (`gq`) for reflowing text to the configured line width over motions and text objects.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers the rewrap operator actions for motions and text objects.

nodes.name: rewrap_motion
nodes.summary: Reflows text within the buffer range spanned by a motion.

nodes.name: rewrap_object
nodes.summary: Reflows text within the buffer range spanned by a text object.

nodes.name: state.rs

nodes.name: input_ignored

nodes.name: Vim

nodes.name: VimAddon
nodes.summary: Editor addon wrapper that attaches the Vim state to a GPUI Editor instance.

nodes.name: visual.rs
nodes.summary: Implements vim visual mode (character, line, and block selection variants): motion/object-driven selection extension, delete/yank/replace within selections, and search-based selection extension (`gn`).

nodes.name: register

nodes.name: visual_motion
