nodes.name: visual_block_motion
nodes.summary: Extends a visual-block (column) selection using a motion, maintaining rectangular column alignment.

nodes.name: visual_object
nodes.summary: Extends the active visual selection to cover a text object.

nodes.name: visual_delete
nodes.summary: Deletes the text covered by the active visual selection.

nodes.name: visual_yank
nodes.summary: Yanks the text covered by the active visual selection into a register.

nodes.name: select_match
nodes.summary: Extends the visual selection to include the next occurrence of the current search match, implementing vim's `gn` command.

nodes.name: cursor_excerpt.rs
nodes.summary: Computes the text excerpt surrounding the cursor to send as context for edit prediction, using syntax-aware and linewise expansion strategies bounded by a token budget.

nodes.name: compute_cursor_excerpt
nodes.summary: Computes the excerpt range around the cursor to use as prediction context, dispatching to syntax-aware or linewise expansion.

nodes.name: expand_symmetric_from_cursor
nodes.summary: Expands an excerpt range symmetrically outward from the cursor up to a token budget.

nodes.name: compute_syntax_ranges
nodes.summary: Computes candidate syntax-tree node ranges enclosing the cursor for syntax-aware excerpt expansion.

nodes.name: expand_context_syntactically_then_linewise
nodes.summary: Expands the excerpt first along syntax-tree boundaries, then falls back to linewise expansion to fill the remaining token budget.

nodes.name: containing_syntax_boundaries
nodes.summary: Finds the nearest enclosing syntax node boundaries around a point.

nodes.name: expand_linewise_biased
nodes.summary: Expands the excerpt range line-by-line, biased toward including more lines after the cursor than before.

nodes.name: data_collection.rs
nodes.summary: Captures training/telemetry data for edit prediction: cursor context, uncommitted git diffs, and formatted excerpts used to build prediction examples.

nodes.name: capture_prediction_context
nodes.summary: Captures the full context (cursor excerpt, diffs, events) around a prediction request for data collection purposes.

nodes.name: uncommitted_diffs_for_events
nodes.summary: Computes uncommitted git diffs for the files touched by recent edit events.

nodes.name: compute_cursor_excerpt
nodes.summary: Computes the cursor excerpt used for a captured data collection sample.

nodes.name: compute_uncommitted_diff
nodes.summary: Computes the uncommitted diff for a single buffer against its git base.

nodes.name: format_cursor_excerpt
nodes.summary: Formats a cursor excerpt into the textual representation used in collected training examples.

nodes.name: CapturedPredictionContext
nodes.summary: Holds the captured context (excerpt, diffs, metadata) for a single edit-prediction data-collection sample.

nodes.name: edit_prediction.rs
nodes.summary: Core edit-prediction crate module defining the EditPredictionStore that orchestrates requesting, caching, rating, and applying AI-generated edit suggestions across all supported providers (Zeta, Mercury, FIM, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible), plus telemetry and settled-prediction batching.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large orchestration module (3500+ lines) acting as the crate root that ties together every prediction backend and manages per-project/per-buffer prediction state, request debouncing, and rejection/acceptance telemetry.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the EditPredictionStore, initializing provider configuration and subscribing to project/buffer events.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Crate entry point that registers the EditPredictionStore as a global and wires up related settings.

nodes.name: register_buffer_impl
nodes.summary: Registers a buffer for edit-prediction tracking, subscribing to its edit events.

nodes.name: report_changes_for_buffer
nodes.summary: Processes buffer edit events, recording them as prediction-relevant events and triggering data collection capture.

nodes.name: prediction_at
nodes.summary: Returns the current pending or active edit prediction applicable at a given cursor position.

nodes.name: accept_current_prediction
nodes.summary: Applies the currently displayed edit prediction to the buffer and records acceptance telemetry.

nodes.name: reject_current_prediction
nodes.summary: Rejects and clears the currently displayed edit prediction, recording rejection telemetry.

nodes.name: queue_prediction_refresh
nodes.summary: Debounces and schedules a refreshed prediction request for a buffer after an edit, coordinating with the active provider.

nodes.name: request_prediction_internal
nodes.summary: Dispatches a prediction request to the active provider backend (Zeta, Mercury, FIM, Ollama, or OpenAI-compatible) based on configuration.

nodes.name: send_v3_request

nodes.name: send_v4_request

nodes.name: collect_editable_context
nodes.summary: Collects the editable file context (recently opened/viewed files) to send along with a prediction request.

nodes.name: rate_prediction
nodes.summary: Records a user-submitted quality rating for a previously issued edit prediction.

nodes.name: EditPredictionStore
nodes.summary: Central global state entity tracking registered projects/buffers, active provider, pending predictions, and telemetry for the edit-prediction feature.

nodes.name: EditPredictionModel
nodes.summary: Enum selecting which edit-prediction backend/model is active (Zeta, Mercury, FIM, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible).

nodes.name: DebugEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of debug telemetry events emitted during context retrieval and prediction lifecycle for inspection tooling.

nodes.name: Zeta2RawConfig

nodes.name: example_spec.rs

nodes.name: write_path_list
nodes.summary: Serializes a list of file paths into the markdown example-spec format.

nodes.name: parse_path_list
nodes.summary: Parses a markdown-formatted list of file paths from an example spec.

nodes.name: to_markdown
nodes.summary: Serializes an ExampleSpec (cursor excerpt, patches, feedback) into its markdown file representation.

nodes.name: from_markdown
nodes.summary: Parses an ExampleSpec back from its markdown file representation.

nodes.name: cursor_excerpt
nodes.summary: Extracts the cursor excerpt text embedded in an ExampleSpec.

nodes.name: ExampleSpec

nodes.name: HumanFeedback

nodes.name: request_prediction
nodes.summary: Sends a fill-in-the-middle prediction request to the configured FIM-compatible model endpoint and parses the completion.

nodes.name: format_fim_prompt
nodes.summary: Formats the prefix/suffix cursor context into the FIM-style prompt expected by the model.

nodes.summary: Returns the model-specific stop tokens used to terminate FIM completions.

nodes.name: clean_fim_completion

nodes.name: license_detection.rs

nodes.name: spdx_identifier

nodes.name: patterns
nodes.summary: Returns the set of text-matching patterns used to detect each known open-source license.

nodes.name: parse_pattern
nodes.summary: Parses a license-matching pattern definition into a compiled matcher.

nodes.name: check_pattern
nodes.summary: Checks license file text against a compiled pattern to determine a match.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a LicenseDetectionWatcher that monitors a project's license file and updates its detected-license state.

nodes.name: is_path_eligible
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given file path is eligible for data collection based on the project's detected license.

nodes.name: LicenseDetectionWatcher
nodes.summary: Watches a project's license file and exposes the currently detected open-source license state.

nodes.name: mercury.rs

nodes.name: request_prediction
nodes.summary: Sends a prediction request to the Mercury API and parses the returned edit suggestion.

nodes.name: build_prompt

nodes.name: send_feedback
nodes.summary: Sends acceptance/rejection feedback for a prediction back to the Mercury API.

nodes.name: EditPredictionResult

nodes.summary: Applies a parsed unified diff's hunks to the corresponding buffers/files.

nodes.summary: Refreshes cached worktree file entries referenced by a diff before applying edits.

nodes.name: request_prediction_with_zeta
nodes.summary: Sends a prediction request to the Zeta backend, building the prompt from context and parsing the response into an EditPredictionResult.

nodes.name: handle_api_response
nodes.summary: Parses the raw Zeta API response into structured prediction output, handling error cases.

nodes.name: active_buffer_diagnostics
nodes.summary: Collects active diagnostics for the buffer to include as additional prediction context.

nodes.name: zeta2_prompt_input
