nodes.name: edit_prediction_accepted
nodes.summary: Reports acceptance telemetry for a Zeta-backed prediction back to the service.

nodes.name: compute_edits_and_cursor_position
nodes.summary: Computes the final buffer edits and resulting cursor position from a resolved Zeta prediction.

nodes.name: buffer.rs
nodes.summary: The heart of the language crate: defines the collaborative text Buffer and its immutable BufferSnapshot, layering CRDT text editing, tree-sitter syntax parsing, autoindent, diagnostics, outlines, bracket matching, and file-backed persistence into a single editable document model. This is the core data structure every editor pane and the planned markdown/LaTeX/Jupyter surfaces will build on.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses tree-sitter parsing coupled with a CRDT (Lamport-timestamped operations) so buffers can be edited collaboratively while maintaining an incrementally-parsed SyntaxMap; snapshots are cheaply cloneable immutable views.

nodes.name: Buffer
nodes.summary: The mutable, GPUI-entity document model wrapping CRDT text, an associated Language, a live SyntaxMap, diagnostics, and file state; exposes editing, transactions, undo/redo, autoindent, reparse, reload/save, and collaboration (apply_op) APIs.

nodes.name: BufferSnapshot
nodes.summary: Immutable, cheaply-cloneable read-only view of a Buffer at a version, providing syntax-layer queries, outline extraction, bracket ranges, chunk highlighting, diagnostics-in-range, and word/scope classification without borrowing the live buffer.

nodes.name: File
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the on-disk (or remote) file backing a buffer, exposing path, mtime, disk state, and load/save hooks so buffers stay decoupled from the concrete filesystem or worktree.

nodes.name: CharClassifier
nodes.summary: Classifies characters as word, whitespace, or punctuation according to the active language scope, powering word-boundary navigation, selection expansion, and completion triggers.

nodes.name: HighlightedTextBuilder
nodes.summary: Accumulates styled and plain text runs from buffer ranges into a HighlightedText, used to render syntax- and diff-highlighted previews.

nodes.name: diagnostic.rs
nodes.summary: Single-line re-export/stub module for diagnostic types; currently a placeholder pulling diagnostic definitions into the crate namespace.

nodes.name: diagnostic_set.rs
nodes.summary: Stores a buffer's diagnostics as an anchor-indexed sum tree (DiagnosticSet), supporting range queries, grouping related diagnostics, severity summaries, and conversion to LSP diagnostic stubs.
nodes.languageNotes: Diagnostics are keyed by text Anchors and stored in a SumTree so they survive edits and support efficient range/group queries.

nodes.name: DiagnosticSet
nodes.summary: Anchor-indexed collection of diagnostic entries with range iteration, group extraction, and severity summarization for a buffer.

nodes.name: file_content.rs
nodes.summary: Heuristics for sniffing raw file bytes: detects binary content, known binary headers, and plausible UTF-16 text so buffers can decide whether a file is loadable as text and which encoding to use.

nodes.name: analyze_byte_content
nodes.summary: Inspects a byte slice to classify it as UTF-8 text, UTF-16 text, or binary, returning a ByteContent verdict used when opening files.

nodes.name: language.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root and central module of the language crate: defines the Language type (grammar, queries, config, LSP adapters), the LspAdapter/LspInstaller traits, LanguageScope, and re-exports every sibling module. This is where a language's tree-sitter grammar, highlight/outline/bracket queries, and language-server integration are bound together.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses thread-local tree-sitter Parser and QueryCursor pools (with_parser/with_query_cursor) to avoid repeated allocation during highlighting.

nodes.name: Language
nodes.summary: Bundles a tree-sitter grammar with its highlight, outline, bracket, indent, injection, override, runnable, and text-object queries plus config, context provider, and toolchain lister — the complete definition of one supported language.

nodes.name: LspAdapter
nodes.summary: Trait defining how a language integrates with a language server: server command discovery, completion/symbol label formatting, diagnostic processing, initialization options, and settings schema.

nodes.name: LanguageScope
nodes.summary: Represents the (possibly injected/overridden) language context at a point in a buffer, exposing scope-specific brackets, comment prefixes, word characters, and autoclose rules.

nodes.name: CachedLspAdapter
nodes.summary: Wraps an LspAdapter with cached metadata (name, id, capabilities) to avoid repeatedly querying the adapter during language-server lifecycle management.

nodes.name: rust_lang
nodes.summary: Test/factory helper constructing a fully configured Rust Language with its grammar and queries, used in tests and as a reference wiring of a language definition.

nodes.name: markdown_lang
nodes.summary: Test/factory helper constructing a Markdown Language definition; directly relevant to the fork's markdown-first note-taking roadmap.

nodes.name: language_registry.rs
nodes.summary: Global registry that owns all available languages and grammars, resolves the language for a filename/path/modeline, lazily loads grammars (native or WASM), and manages registration of real and fake LSP adapters for tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Grammars can be loaded from compiled-in native tree-sitter functions or from WASM modules, with lazy on-demand loading and precedence-based language matching.

nodes.name: LanguageRegistry
nodes.summary: Central catalog of languages, grammars, and LSP adapters; resolves languages by name/extension/path/modeline and lazily loads their grammars and queries on demand.

nodes.name: language_for_file_internal
nodes.summary: Core resolution routine that picks the best-matching language for a file by combining path suffix, first-line/modeline hints, and match precedence.

nodes.name: load_language
nodes.summary: Asynchronously loads a language's grammar and query files, constructing a fully-wired Language and caching it in the registry.

nodes.name: language_settings.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the layered, per-language editor settings model (tab size, soft wrap, formatters, inlay hints, edit predictions, completions) and resolves effective settings by merging global defaults, language overrides, modelines, and editorconfig.
nodes.languageNotes: Settings are resolved through a merge chain (global -> language -> modeline -> editorconfig) so the most local source wins.

nodes.name: LanguageSettings
nodes.summary: The resolved set of per-language editor behaviors (indentation, wrapping, formatting, completions, inlay hints) applied to a buffer at a location.

nodes.name: AllLanguageSettings
nodes.summary: Top-level settings container holding defaults plus per-language overrides, exposing for_buffer resolution to produce effective LanguageSettings.

nodes.name: from_settings
nodes.summary: Builds AllLanguageSettings from deserialized user/default settings content, translating the raw config schema into the runtime settings model.

nodes.name: manifest.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ManifestProvider and ManifestDelegate traits plus ManifestQuery, an abstraction for locating a project's manifest file (e.g., Cargo.toml, package.json) used for toolchain and language-server discovery.

nodes.name: modeline.rs
nodes.summary: Parses Emacs and Vim modelines embedded in file headers/footers to extract per-file settings (indentation, mode, tab handling) that override language and global settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Supports both Emacs local-variable/-*- lines and Vim 'set' modelines, mapping their directives onto ModelineSettings.

nodes.name: parse_modeline
nodes.summary: Entry point that scans a file's leading/trailing lines and dispatches to the Emacs or Vim modeline parser, returning extracted ModelineSettings.

nodes.name: outline.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Outline and OutlineItem structures (symbol tree extracted from a buffer via tree-sitter outline queries) and fuzzy-search over them, powering the symbol outline panel and go-to-symbol.

nodes.name: Outline
nodes.summary: A searchable tree of OutlineItems representing a buffer's symbols with fuzzy matching and hierarchy expansion.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Fuzzy-matches a query string against the outline's symbols, returning ranked OutlineSearchEntry results for the symbol picker.

nodes.name: proto.rs
nodes.summary: Serialization layer converting buffer operations, edits, selections, diagnostics, anchors, transactions, and versions to and from protobuf wire types for collaborative editing over the network.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides symmetric serialize_*/deserialize_* pairs for the CRDT operation set, forming the wire protocol for real-time collaboration.

nodes.name: serialize_operation
nodes.summary: Encodes a buffer Operation (edit, undo, selection change, etc.) into its protobuf representation for transmission to collaborators.

nodes.name: deserialize_operation
nodes.summary: Decodes a protobuf-encoded buffer Operation back into the runtime Operation enum applied to a Buffer.

nodes.name: runnable.rs
nodes.summary: Extracts runnable code regions (tests, main functions, etc.) from a buffer using tree-sitter runnable queries, grouping captures into tagged RunnableRanges that surface run/debug affordances in the gutter.
nodes.languageNotes: Runnables are discovered by matching a language's runnable.scm query and grouping the resulting captures into tagged, resolvable run targets.

nodes.name: runnable_ranges
nodes.summary: Scans a buffer range with the language's runnable query and returns the RunnableRanges (with tags) found within it.

nodes.name: syntax_map.rs
nodes.summary: Implements incremental tree-sitter parsing with language injection: SyntaxMap/SyntaxSnapshot maintain a layered forest of syntax trees, reparsing only changed regions, resolving injected sub-languages, and exposing capture/match iterators for highlighting, outlines, and brackets.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains a SumTree of syntax layers keyed by anchor ranges; interpolate() shifts layers across edits and reparse_with_ranges() re-parses only invalidated regions, including recursively resolving language injections.

nodes.name: SyntaxMap
nodes.summary: Mutable owner of a buffer's incremental syntax state; drives interpolation across edits and reparse cycles, producing SyntaxSnapshots.

nodes.name: SyntaxSnapshot
nodes.summary: Immutable layered forest of tree-sitter trees at a buffer version, offering capture/match iteration, layer queries by range, and injection resolution for highlighting and structural queries.

nodes.name: reparse_with_ranges
nodes.summary: The core incremental reparser: re-runs tree-sitter over invalidated regions, resolves and re-parses injected languages, and rebuilds the affected syntax layers.

nodes.name: get_injections
nodes.summary: Runs a layer's injection query to discover embedded sub-language regions (e.g., code fences, embedded SQL) and schedules them as new parse steps.

nodes.name: task_context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ContextProvider trait and ContextLocation, letting a language contribute task/run variables (e.g., current symbol, file, test name) resolved from a buffer position.

nodes.name: text_diff.rs
nodes.summary: Line-, word-, and char-level diffing utilities producing unified diffs (optionally with byte offsets) and applying/reversing diff patches, used for edit previews, git-style hunks, and reload merging.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps the imara/similar diff engine and augments it with offset tracking and intra-hunk word diffing for finer-grained highlighting.

nodes.name: text_diff_with_options
nodes.summary: Computes a configurable text diff between two strings, controlling granularity (line/word/char) and returning the resulting change ranges.

nodes.name: toolchain.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ToolchainLister and LanguageToolchainStore traits for discovering and storing language toolchains (e.g., Python virtualenvs, Rust toolchains) associated with a worktree.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate entry point for the `languages` crate: `init` registers every bundled grammar, LSP adapter, context/task/toolchain provider, and manifest provider into the shared LanguageRegistry, wiring per-language modules into the editor at startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `pub use language::*` to re-export the language framework and gates grammars/adapters behind cargo features (e.g. `load-grammars`, `tree-sitter-gitcommit`).

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Bootstraps all bundled language support: registers native grammars, constructs each LSP adapter (bash, c/cpp, css, eslint, go, json, python variants, rust, tailwind, typescript/vtsls, yaml) and registers them plus task, context, and toolchain providers with the LanguageRegistry.

nodes.name: register_language
nodes.summary: Helper that registers a single language definition and its associated config, grammar, and providers with the registry given the language name and its supporting components.

nodes.name: LanguageInfo
nodes.summary: Struct bundling the metadata and provider handles for a single registrable language (config, grammar, adapters, providers).

nodes.name: bash.rs
nodes.summary: Bash language support: the BashLspAdapter downloads and caches the bash-language-server binary and provides task context, exposing shell-script diagnostics and completions to the editor.

nodes.name: BashLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter implementation for bash-language-server: resolves, fetches, caches, and version-checks the server binary via npm and reports its name to the registry.

nodes.name: bash_task_context
nodes.summary: Builds the task context (environment variables and template variables) used when running bash tasks in the editor.

nodes.name: fetch_server_binary
nodes.summary: Downloads the resolved bash-language-server package and returns the launch binary descriptor for the LSP server.

nodes.name: c.rs
nodes.summary: C language support: the CLspAdapter manages the clangd binary and provides rich completion/symbol label formatting and diagnostic tuning for C source files.

nodes.name: CLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for clangd: fetches/caches the server binary with architecture checks and formats completion and symbol labels for the C language.

nodes.name: label_for_completion
nodes.summary: Constructs highlighted, syntax-aware display labels for clangd completion items, mapping LSP completion kinds to C code snippets for the completion popup.

nodes.name: label_for_symbol
nodes.summary: Builds highlighted display labels for C workspace/document symbols returned by clangd for the symbol outline and search.

nodes.name: fetch_server_binary
nodes.summary: Downloads and unpacks the clangd release asset for the current platform and returns the launch descriptor.

nodes.name: cpp.rs
nodes.summary: C++ language support that supplies semantic token highlighting rules; shares the clangd adapter with C via the sibling c module.

nodes.name: semantic_token_rules
nodes.summary: Returns the semantic token highlighting rules that map clangd's semantic token types/modifiers to editor highlight styles for C++.

nodes.name: css.rs
nodes.summary: CSS language support: the CssLspAdapter manages the vscode-css-language-server binary via npm and supplies its initialization and workspace configuration.

nodes.name: CssLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the VS Code CSS language server: fetches/caches the npm package and provides initialization options and workspace configuration.

nodes.name: workspace_configuration
nodes.summary: Assembles the workspace configuration JSON sent to the CSS language server, merging user settings with defaults.

nodes.name: eslint.rs
nodes.summary: ESLint integration: the EsLintLspAdapter builds and runs the vscode-eslint language server, discovering flat/legacy config files, resolving working directories, and translating Zed settings into ESLint server configuration.

nodes.name: EsLintLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the ESLint language server: builds the server from a vendored bundle, exposes code-action kinds, and produces workspace configuration reflecting discovered ESLint config.

nodes.name: workspace_configuration
nodes.summary: Computes the per-worktree ESLint server configuration, resolving config file kind, working directories, and Zed setting overrides into the server's expected shape.

nodes.name: determine_working_directory
nodes.summary: Resolves the ESLint working directory for a file by walking ancestor directories and matching configured working-directory modes and glob patterns.

nodes.name: find_eslint_config_kind
nodes.summary: Detects whether a directory uses a flat or legacy ESLint config by probing for the known config file names.

nodes.name: fetch_server_binary
nodes.summary: Fetches, checks out, and builds the vscode-eslint language server from source into the cached destination path.

nodes.name: go.rs
nodes.summary: Go language support: the GoLspAdapter manages gopls plus context and runnable-resolver providers, offering completion/symbol labels, semantic tokens, and Go test task templates.

nodes.name: GoLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for gopls: fetches/caches the server, supplies initialization and workspace config, and formats completion and symbol labels for Go.

nodes.name: GoContextProvider
nodes.summary: ContextProvider for Go that builds task context and associated test/run tasks (go test templates) for the current file and package.

nodes.name: GoRunnableResolver
nodes.summary: Resolves runnable Go targets (tests/subtests) into concrete run commands for the editor's runnables feature.

nodes.name: label_for_completion
nodes.summary: Produces highlighted, structured completion labels for gopls items, rendering Go signatures and kinds for the completion menu.

nodes.name: associated_tasks
nodes.summary: Generates the set of Go test/run task templates associated with a file, including package tests, function tests, and subtests.

nodes.name: build_context
nodes.summary: Builds the Go task context by collecting module, package, and symbol variables used to expand task templates.

nodes.name: fetch_server_binary
nodes.summary: Installs gopls via the Go toolchain and returns the launch descriptor for the resolved binary.

nodes.name: json.rs
nodes.summary: JSON language support: the JsonLspAdapter manages vscode-json-languageserver with dynamic JSON schema registration, plus a NodeVersionAdapter and a task provider for package.json scripts.

nodes.name: JsonLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the JSON language server: fetches/caches the server and supplies workspace configuration that registers Zed's JSON schemas for settings/keymap files.

nodes.name: NodeVersionAdapter
nodes.summary: Adapter that manages a versioned Node-based server binary, resolving and caching a specific pinned version.

nodes.name: JsonTaskProvider
nodes.summary: ContextProvider that surfaces package.json script entries as runnable tasks for JSON files.

nodes.name: workspace_configuration
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON language server workspace configuration, registering the set of JSON schema associations for known Zed config files.

nodes.name: associated_tasks
nodes.summary: Derives runnable task templates from a project's package.json scripts, detecting the package manager and building run commands.

nodes.name: package_json.rs
nodes.summary: Shared package.json parsing utilities: models package.json contents and detects the project's package manager from the manifest or devEngines, reused by the JSON, TypeScript, and ESLint adapters.

nodes.name: PackageJsonData
nodes.summary: Parsed representation of a package.json (scripts, dependencies, package manager info) with a merge operation for combining nested manifests.

nodes.name: PackageJsonData::new
nodes.summary: Parses raw package.json bytes into structured PackageJsonData, extracting scripts, package-manager declarations, and dev engines.

nodes.name: python.rs
nodes.summary: Python language support and the largest adapter set in the crate: LSP adapters for Pyright/BasedPyright/Ty/Pylsp/Ruff, a virtualenv-aware toolchain provider, context/task providers for pytest/unittest, and pyproject.toml manifest handling. Central to the fork's Jupyter/physics-notebook roadmap.
nodes.languageNotes: Bundles five distinct Python language servers behind separate adapters and includes a PythonToolchainProvider that discovers venv/conda/micromamba environments and generates activation scripts.

nodes.name: PyrightLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for Pyright: fetches/caches the npm server, formats completion/symbol labels, and supplies workspace configuration honoring the active Python interpreter.

nodes.name: BasedPyrightLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the BasedPyright fork of Pyright, providing the same completion/config surface bound to the based-pyright server package.

nodes.name: PyLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for python-lsp-server (pylsp) that ensures a dedicated venv, installs the server, and supplies its workspace configuration.

nodes.name: TyLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the Ty (Astral) Python type checker/language server, managing its binary and label/config surface.

nodes.name: RuffLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the Ruff linter/formatter server, fetching the binary and translating Ruff configuration schema into initialization options.

nodes.name: PythonToolchainProvider
nodes.summary: ToolchainProvider that discovers Python environments (venv, conda, micromamba, global), ranks them by priority/proximity, and turns each into an activatable toolchain.

nodes.name: PythonContextProvider
nodes.summary: ContextProvider that builds Python task context and associated pytest/unittest/module run tasks from the active file and interpreter.

nodes.name: PythonToolchainProvider::activation_script
nodes.summary: Generates the shell activation script for a discovered Python environment, handling venv, conda, and micromamba activation across shells.

nodes.name: PythonToolchainProvider::list
nodes.summary: Enumerates all candidate Python toolchains for a worktree by scanning known environment locations and interpreter declarations.

nodes.name: convert_ruff_schema
nodes.summary: Translates the Ruff settings schema into the initialization-options shape the Ruff language server expects.

nodes.name: PythonContextProvider::associated_tasks
nodes.summary: Builds pytest/unittest/module run task templates for a Python file, choosing the test runner and target from context.

nodes.name: PyprojectTomlManifestProvider
nodes.summary: ManifestProvider that recognizes pyproject.toml as a project root marker for Python worktrees.

nodes.name: rust.rs
nodes.summary: Rust language support: the RustLspAdapter drives rust-analyzer (via rustup or downloaded binary), formats completion/symbol labels, and pairs with a context provider and cargo manifest/metadata handling for Cargo test/run tasks.

nodes.name: RustLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for rust-analyzer: resolves the server via rustup or a downloaded release, formats labels, converts the settings schema, and processes disk-based diagnostics.

nodes.name: RustContextProvider
nodes.summary: ContextProvider that builds Rust task context and associated cargo test/run tasks, resolving target info from Cargo metadata.

nodes.name: CargoManifestProvider
nodes.summary: ManifestProvider that recognizes Cargo.toml as a project root marker for Rust worktrees.

nodes.name: label_for_completion
nodes.summary: Builds richly highlighted completion labels for rust-analyzer items, rendering Rust signatures, kinds, and detail text for the completion menu.

nodes.name: associated_tasks
nodes.summary: Generates cargo test/run/bench task templates for a Rust file, resolving package and target info to build the run commands.

nodes.name: build_context
nodes.summary: Assembles the Rust task context with package, target, and symbol variables used to expand cargo task templates.

nodes.name: fetch_server_binary
nodes.summary: Downloads and unpacks the rust-analyzer release matching the platform (libc/arch aware) and returns the launch descriptor.

nodes.name: convert_rust_analyzer_schema
nodes.summary: Converts the rust-analyzer settings JSON schema into the initialization-options shape expected by the server.

nodes.name: tailwind.rs
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS language support: the TailwindLspAdapter manages the Tailwind CSS language server and declares the set of language IDs whose files receive Tailwind class completions.

nodes.name: TailwindLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the Tailwind CSS language server: fetches/caches the npm server and supplies initialization, workspace config, and the mapped language IDs.

nodes.name: tailwindcss.rs
nodes.summary: Alternate/newer Tailwind CSS adapter (TailwindCssLspAdapter) managing the Tailwind CSS language server binary with its own initialization and workspace configuration.

nodes.name: TailwindCssLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the Tailwind CSS language server: fetches/caches the npm package and provides initialization and workspace configuration.

nodes.name: typescript.rs
nodes.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript language support: the TypeScriptLspAdapter manages typescript-language-server, resolves the tsdk path and TS versions, and pairs with a context provider that mines package.json scripts and jest/vitest task templates.

nodes.name: TypeScriptLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for typescript-language-server: fetches/caches the server, resolves the TS SDK path, formats completion labels, and supplies initialization and workspace configuration.

nodes.name: TypeScriptContextProvider
nodes.summary: ContextProvider that builds TS/JS task context, detects the package manager, and generates run/test task templates from package.json scripts and test frameworks.

nodes.name: fill_task_templates
nodes.summary: Populates the TypeScript/JavaScript task template set (jest/vitest/mocha/node run commands) parameterized by test name and package manager.

nodes.name: build_context
nodes.summary: Builds the TS/JS task context, resolving package.json data, package manager, and symbol variables for task expansion.

nodes.name: vtsls.rs
nodes.summary: vtsls language support: the VtslsLspAdapter manages the vtsls TypeScript language server (a wrapper around tsserver), enhancing diagnostics and providing completion labels and workspace configuration.

nodes.name: VtslsLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for vtsls: fetches/caches the server, resolves the tsdk path, formats completions, enhances diagnostic messages, and processes server prompt responses.

nodes.name: workspace_configuration
nodes.summary: Builds the vtsls workspace configuration JSON, merging TypeScript/JavaScript inlay-hint and preference settings from Zed config.

nodes.name: process_prompt_response
nodes.summary: Handles interactive prompt responses from the vtsls server, mapping user choices back into server actions.

nodes.name: yaml.rs
nodes.summary: YAML language support: the YamlLspAdapter manages the yaml-language-server, resolving the worktree root and supplying workspace configuration (including schema associations) for YAML files.

nodes.name: YamlLspAdapter
nodes.summary: LspAdapter for the YAML language server: fetches/caches the npm server, resolves the worktree root, and provides workspace configuration for YAML schema validation.

nodes.name: workspace_configuration
nodes.summary: Builds the YAML language server workspace configuration, wiring user schema settings and formatting options.

nodes.name: dispatcher.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MacDispatcher, GPUI's macOS platform dispatcher that schedules work onto Grand Central Dispatch queues for background and main-thread execution, including delayed dispatch and realtime audio-thread priority handling.

nodes.name: MacDispatcher
nodes.summary: Platform dispatcher backed by libdispatch queues, implementing GPUI's PlatformDispatcher trait for task scheduling, delayed execution, and thread-priority control on macOS.

nodes.name: display.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps NSScreen to implement GPUI's PlatformDisplay trait, exposing macOS display enumeration, UUID identification, and bounds/visible-bounds queries.

nodes.name: MacDisplay
nodes.summary: Represents a single macOS display/screen, providing lookup by ID, primary-display access, enumeration of all displays, and geometry queries.

nodes.name: display_link.rs
nodes.summary: Manages CVDisplayLink subscriptions used to drive GPUI's frame timing, providing a registry that lets multiple windows on the same display share one display-link callback and receive per-frame timing events.

nodes.name: WindowFrameSource
nodes.summary: Per-window handle into the shared display-link registry, used to start and stop frame-timing notifications for a specific window.

nodes.name: Registry
nodes.summary: Process-wide registry mapping display IDs to shared CVDisplayLink entries and their subscriber callbacks.

nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: Translates native AppKit NSEvent objects into GPUI's platform-agnostic input events, covering keystrokes, modifiers, mouse events, and macOS-specific keyboard layout quirks.

nodes.name: platform_input_from_native
nodes.summary: Converts a native NSEvent into GPUI's PlatformInput enum, dispatching by event type to build mouse, keyboard, or scroll events with correct coordinates and modifiers.

nodes.name: parse_keystroke
nodes.summary: Parses a native key-down/up NSEvent into a GPUI Keystroke, resolving key codes, modifiers, and IME-affected characters.

nodes.name: key_to_native
nodes.summary: Maps a GPUI logical key name back to the native macOS virtual key code, used for synthesizing or matching key equivalents.

nodes.name: chars_for_modified_key
nodes.summary: Resolves the characters produced by a key code under a given modifier combination using the current keyboard layout, needed for correct key-equivalent matching.

nodes.name: gpui_macos.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the macOS GPUI platform backend; declares all platform submodules and provides small Objective-C interop extension traits (bool/NSString/NSRange conversions) shared across the crate.

nodes.name: NSRange
nodes.summary: Bridges Rust Range<usize> to Objective-C NSRange for use in AppKit text-input APIs.

nodes.name: keyboard.rs
nodes.summary: Implements macOS keyboard layout detection and key-equivalent mapping, including a large generated table of layout-specific key equivalents used to resolve menu shortcuts correctly across international keyboard layouts.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains an extremely large generated match/lookup table (~1400 lines) mapping keyboard layout IDs to key equivalents.

nodes.name: MacKeyboardLayout
nodes.summary: Represents the currently active macOS keyboard layout, exposing its id and display name.

nodes.name: MacKeyboardMapper
nodes.summary: Maps keystrokes to layout-correct key equivalents for menu items and shortcuts on the current keyboard layout.

nodes.name: metal_atlas.rs
nodes.summary: GPU texture atlas backed by Metal textures, implementing GPUI's PlatformAtlas trait to pack sprites/glyphs into shared textures for the Metal renderer using etagere-based rectangle packing.

nodes.name: MetalAtlas
nodes.summary: Public handle to the Metal-backed sprite atlas, exposed to the renderer for texture allocation and lookup.

nodes.name: MetalAtlasState
nodes.summary: Internal mutable state of the atlas tracking allocated textures, tile packers, and tile-to-texture mappings.

nodes.name: MetalAtlasTexture
nodes.summary: Wraps a single Metal texture used as an atlas page, tracking its rectangle allocator and reference counts for eviction.

nodes.name: metal_renderer.rs
nodes.summary: Core Metal GPU renderer for GPUI on macOS: builds render/compute pipelines and draws quads, shadows, underlines, glyph sprites, surfaces, and vector paths from a GPUI Scene, including an offscreen headless renderer for image export.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of raw Metal API bindings (pipeline states, command encoders, buffers) with per-primitive-type draw functions.

nodes.name: MetalRenderer
nodes.summary: Main GPU renderer that owns the Metal device, pipeline states, and instance buffers, and draws a GPUI Scene to a CAMetalLayer drawable or offscreen image.

nodes.name: MetalHeadlessRenderer
nodes.summary: Headless variant of the Metal renderer used to rasterize scenes to images without an on-screen surface, e.g. for testing or export.

nodes.name: InstanceBufferPool
nodes.summary: Pool of reusable GPU instance buffers acquired and released per frame to avoid per-frame allocation overhead.

nodes.name: new_internal
nodes.summary: Constructs the Metal renderer's pipeline states, shader library, and intermediate textures shared by both windowed and headless renderer construction paths.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders a GPUI Scene to the current drawable, coordinating buffer acquisition, command encoding, and presentation for a single frame.

nodes.name: draw_primitives_to_texture
nodes.summary: Encodes draw calls for all scene primitive layers (shadows, quads, paths, underlines, sprites, surfaces) into a Metal render pass targeting a texture.

nodes.name: open_type.rs
nodes.summary: Applies OpenType font features and fallback fonts to a CoreText font descriptor, translating GPUI font feature/fallback settings into Core Text feature arrays.

nodes.name: apply_features_and_fallbacks
nodes.summary: Builds a new CoreText font with the given OpenType features and fallback fonts applied via font descriptor attributes.

nodes.name: generate_fallback_array
nodes.summary: Constructs a CoreText fallback font descriptor array from GPUI's list of fallback font names.

nodes.name: pasteboard.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps NSPasteboard to implement GPUI clipboard read/write operations, supporting plain text and multiple image formats (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO, TIFF, PNM) via a UTType abstraction.

nodes.name: Pasteboard
nodes.summary: Handle to a system or custom NSPasteboard, providing read/write access for clipboard items including text and images.

nodes.name: UTType
nodes.summary: Enumerates supported uniform type identifiers for pasteboard image formats and maps them to their UTI strings.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes a clipboard item (text and/or image) to the pasteboard with the appropriate UTI type declarations.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads the current pasteboard contents, resolving the best available text or image representation into a GPUI ClipboardItem.

nodes.name: platform.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MacPlatform, the top-level GPUI Platform trait implementation for macOS: application lifecycle, menu bar and dock menu construction, window/display enumeration, file dialogs, clipboard, credentials (Keychain), URL scheme handling, and AppKit delegate callbacks.
nodes.languageNotes: Central façade implementing GPUI's Platform trait; delegates to the other gpui_macos modules (dispatcher, display, pasteboard, keyboard, etc.).

nodes.name: MacPlatform
nodes.summary: Top-level macOS Platform implementation providing application control, window/menu/display management, dialogs, and system integration for GPUI.

nodes.name: MacPlatformState
nodes.summary: Mutable shared state for MacPlatform holding executors, menu callbacks, registered windows, and lifecycle callback closures.

nodes.name: create_menu_item
nodes.summary: Recursively builds a native NSMenuItem tree from GPUI menu definitions, wiring keyboard shortcuts and action targets.

nodes.name: did_finish_launching
nodes.summary: AppKit delegate callback invoked when the application finishes launching, running GPUI's on-finish-launching hook and initializing platform state.

nodes.name: write_credentials
nodes.summary: Stores a URL/username/password credential in the macOS Keychain.

nodes.name: read_credentials
nodes.summary: Retrieves a stored credential from the macOS Keychain for a given URL.

nodes.name: prompt_for_new_path
nodes.summary: Shows a native save-file dialog and resolves the chosen path asynchronously.

nodes.name: screen_capture.rs
nodes.summary: Implements screen/window capture sources and streams on macOS using ScreenCaptureKit, exposing available capture sources and delivering sampled video frames to GPUI callbacks.

nodes.name: MacScreenCaptureSource
nodes.summary: Represents a capturable screen or window, exposing metadata and the ability to start a capture stream.

nodes.name: MacScreenCaptureStream
nodes.summary: Active ScreenCaptureKit stream delivering captured video frames to a registered frame callback until dropped.

nodes.name: get_sources
nodes.summary: Enumerates available screen and window capture sources via ScreenCaptureKit's shareable content API.

nodes.name: text_system.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MacTextSystem, GPUI's macOS text/font backend built on font-kit and Core Text, handling font loading, glyph rasterization, metrics, and line shaping/layout.

nodes.name: MacTextSystem
nodes.summary: Public GPUI text-system handle for macOS, delegating font lookup, glyph rasterization, and text shaping to internal state.

nodes.name: MacTextSystemState
nodes.summary: Mutable state backing MacTextSystem: loaded font families, glyph metrics caches, and font-kit source handles.

nodes.name: load_family
nodes.summary: Loads a font family by name, applying requested OpenType features and fallback fonts, and registers resulting font handles.

nodes.name: rasterize_glyph
nodes.summary: Rasterizes a single glyph into a bitmap at the requested subpixel position and rendering mode for the sprite atlas.

nodes.name: layout_line
nodes.summary: Shapes a line of text with mixed font runs into positioned glyphs using Core Text line typesetting.

nodes.name: window.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MacWindow, GPUI's macOS PlatformWindow backed by a custom NSWindow/NSView subclass; handles window lifecycle, traffic-light button positioning, tabbing, fullscreen, IME text input, drag-and-drop, accessibility, and all native AppKit event callbacks.
nodes.languageNotes: The largest file in the crate (3200+ lines); defines custom Objective-C classes at runtime via build_classes/build_window_class and routes AppKit delegate callbacks into GPUI's window event model.

nodes.name: MacWindow
nodes.summary: Public handle to a native macOS window, implementing GPUI's PlatformWindow trait for drawing, input handling, IME, and window management.

nodes.name: MacWindowState
nodes.summary: Mutable state backing a MacWindow: renderer, input handler, callback closures for resize/move/close/input events, and traffic-light/titlebar layout data.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Creates and configures a new native NSWindow with the given bounds, titlebar style, and window kind, wiring up the custom view/window classes and display link.

nodes.name: build_classes
nodes.summary: Dynamically registers the custom Objective-C NSWindow and NSView subclasses used by MacWindow, wiring their method implementations for event handling and IME.

nodes.name: handle_key_event
nodes.summary: Processes a native key event, routing it through the IME input context and dispatching resulting GPUI input events to the window's input handler.

nodes.name: handle_view_event
nodes.summary: Dispatches native mouse and scroll NSEvents received by the custom view to GPUI's platform input pipeline.

nodes.name: prompt
nodes.summary: Displays a native modal alert with the given message, detail, and answer buttons, resolving to the chosen answer index asynchronously.

nodes.name: set_background_appearance
nodes.summary: Configures the window's background transparency/blur appearance (opaque, transparent, or blurred) by manipulating the layer and NSVisualEffectView.

nodes.name: window_appearance.rs
nodes.summary: Converts a native NSAppearance name into GPUI's WindowAppearance enum (light/dark/vibrant variants).

nodes.name: window_appearance_from_native
nodes.summary: Maps an NSAppearance name string to GPUI's WindowAppearance enum value.

nodes.name: components.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports the REPL's reusable GPUI UI components (kernel list item and kernel options picker) for use across the crate.

nodes.name: jupyter_settings.rs
nodes.summary: Defines JupyterSettings, holding per-language kernel selections, and reads the Jupyter enable flag from EditorSettings to sidestep a circular dependency between the editor and repl crates.
nodes.languageNotes: The enable flag lives on EditorSettings rather than here specifically to avoid an editor<->repl circular crate dependency — an important extension-point constraint for the fork.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Core kernel abstraction layer for the REPL: defines the RunningKernel trait, Kernel/KernelStatus state machine, and the KernelSpecification enum unifying local Python-env, native, SSH-remote, WSL, and pure-Jupyter kernels, plus Python environment discovery and shell-script bootstrapping.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a trait-object RunningKernel plus a KernelSpecification enum to make the four transport backends (native/remote/ssh/wsl) interchangeable — the primary extension point for adding new kernel launch strategies.

nodes.name: native_kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Launches and manages Jupyter kernels as local child processes over TCP, allocating connection ports, spawning the kernel command, wiring shell/iopub/stdin/control ZMQ channels, and discovering installed kernelspecs from the local filesystem.
nodes.languageNotes: peek_ports binds port 0 to find free TCP ports; the inherent Jupyter race between closing and kernel reuse is accepted by design.

nodes.name: remote_kernels.rs
nodes.summary: Connects to kernels running on a remote Jupyter server over the websocket protocol, launching kernels and listing available kernelspecs via the RemoteServer HTTP/WS API.

nodes.name: ssh_kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Runs Jupyter kernels on an SSH-connected host, tunneling the kernel's ZMQ channels over the remote connection so execution happens remotely while the UI stays local.

nodes.name: wsl_kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Launches Jupyter kernels inside a Windows Subsystem for Linux distribution, quoting POSIX shell arguments, bridging TCP ports between Windows and WSL, and discovering kernelspecs installed within the distribution.
nodes.languageNotes: quote_posix_shell_arguments and a Windows<->WSL port bridge handle the OS boundary; relevant for a Windows-based physics-notebook target platform.

nodes.name: notebook.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports the notebook cell model and notebook UI, exposing the crate's Jupyter-notebook editing surface.

nodes.name: outputs.rs
nodes.summary: Interprets and renders Jupyter kernel output messages — plain text, markdown, PNG/JPEG images, tables, and errors — through the ExecutionView/OutputContent model, with clipboard support, inline-vs-block display, stdin input prompts, and nbformat conversion.
nodes.languageNotes: rank_mime_type selects the richest available MIME representation from a Jupyter MimeBundle; to_nbformat enables round-tripping outputs to the .ipynb schema.

nodes.name: repl.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the REPL/Jupyter integration: declares all submodules, re-exports the public API (Session, Kernel, ReplStore, settings, actions), installs a GPUI-backed async dispatcher, and initializes the REPL subsystem.
nodes.languageNotes: init() bridges async-dispatcher to GPUI's PlatformDispatcher via a ZedDispatcher shim so runtimelib's async tasks run on Zed's executor.

nodes.name: repl_editor.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges the REPL to the code Editor: assigns kernelspecs, installs ipykernel on demand, extracts runnable code ranges (jupytext cells and markdown code blocks), and wires editor actions (run, interrupt, restart, shutdown, clear outputs) to the active Session.
nodes.languageNotes: runnable_ranges/jupytext_cells/markdown_code_blocks define how source is chunked for execution — a key extension point for the fork's markdown+LaTeX notebook workflow.

nodes.name: repl_sessions_ui.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the REPL sessions workspace UI (ReplSessionsPage/ReplSessionsContainer), registers editor actions and command-palette entries, and refreshes Python kernelspecs for the active buffer.

nodes.name: repl_settings.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ReplSettings controlling REPL display behavior — scrollback line/column limits, inline vs block output, inline output length cap, and max output height.

nodes.name: repl_store.rs
nodes.summary: Global state store for the REPL: tracks active sessions, per-worktree kernel specifications and selected kernels, discovers local/remote/WSL/Python-env kernelspecs, manages the enabled flag and command-palette filter, and owns session lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: Registered as a GPUI Global via GlobalReplStore; per-worktree HashMaps let each project directory carry its own kernel selection.

nodes.name: session.rs
nodes.summary: The heart of the REPL: a Session drives a running kernel through its lifecycle, sends execute/interrupt/shutdown/restart requests, routes Jupyter iopub messages to ExecutionViews rendered as editor inlay/block decorations, and handles stdin replies and output placement.
nodes.languageNotes: execute() and replace_block_with_inlay coordinate runtimelib JupyterMessage traffic with GPUI editor decorations — the central orchestration point for cell execution in the notebook UI.

nodes.name: start_kernel_tasks
nodes.summary: Spawns the background tasks that manage a launched kernel's ZMQ channels (shell, iopub, stdin, control), shared across all kernel transport backends.

nodes.name: python_env_kernel_specifications
nodes.summary: Discovers Python environments (venvs, uv, system) and derives kernel specifications from them, including ipykernel availability checks and environment-kind labeling.

nodes.name: build_python_exec_shell_script
nodes.summary: Builds a POSIX shell script that locates and execs the best Python binary with given arguments, used to bootstrap kernels across environments.

nodes.name: Kernel
nodes.summary: Enum-based state wrapper representing a kernel's overall status (starting, running, errored, shutting down), exposing execution-state and kernel-info accessors.

nodes.name: KernelSpecification
nodes.summary: Enum unifying the kinds of kernel a session can launch (local Python-env, native, SSH-remote, WSL), exposing common metadata like name, language, path, and icon.

nodes.name: KernelStatus
nodes.summary: Enumerates the lifecycle states of a kernel and provides connection/shutdown status queries used by the session and UI.

nodes.name: NativeRunningKernel
nodes.summary: A locally-spawned Jupyter kernel process implementing RunningKernel, owning the child process handle, ZMQ channel senders, working directory, and execution state.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a NativeRunningKernel by allocating ports, writing a connection file, spawning the kernel process, and establishing the shell/iopub/stdin/control connections.

nodes.name: local_kernel_specifications
nodes.summary: Scans standard Jupyter kernelspec directories on the local filesystem and parses each kernel.json into a LocalKernelSpecification.

nodes.name: RemoteRunningKernel
nodes.summary: A kernel running on a remote Jupyter server accessed over websockets, implementing RunningKernel with request/stdin senders and execution state.

nodes.name: launch_remote_kernel
nodes.summary: Requests a new kernel from a remote Jupyter server and returns its identifier for subsequent websocket connection.

nodes.name: list_remote_kernelspecs
nodes.summary: Queries a remote Jupyter server for its available kernelspecs and maps them into RemoteKernelSpecification values.

nodes.name: SshRunningKernel
nodes.summary: A Jupyter kernel executing on an SSH host, tunneling its ZMQ channels over the SSH connection while implementing the common RunningKernel interface.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Builds an SshRunningKernel by launching the kernel on the remote host and forwarding its connection ports back over the SSH tunnel.

nodes.name: WslRunningKernel
nodes.summary: A Jupyter kernel running inside a WSL distribution, bridging TCP ports across the Windows/WSL boundary while implementing RunningKernel.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WslRunningKernel by launching the kernel inside WSL with correctly quoted POSIX arguments and bridging its ports to the Windows host.

nodes.name: wsl_kernel_specifications
nodes.summary: Enumerates kernelspecs installed inside a WSL distribution by invoking jupyter kernel discovery within the distro and parsing the results.

nodes.name: ExecutionView
nodes.summary: Manages the collection of outputs for a single code execution, handling incoming Jupyter messages, stdin input prompts, display-data updates, and rendering.

nodes.name: Output
nodes.summary: Represents a single rendered output with its OutputContent, display id, and clipboard/nbformat conversion support.

nodes.name: OutputContent
nodes.summary: Enum encapsulating the supported output content types (text, markdown, image, table, error) with clipboard and buffer accessors.

nodes.name: push_message
nodes.summary: Ingests an incoming Jupyter iopub/stdin message and updates the ExecutionView's outputs accordingly (stream text, display data, errors, input requests).

nodes.name: to_nbformat
nodes.summary: Serializes an output's content into the Jupyter nbformat JSON representation for notebook persistence.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point invoked by the Run action: resolves the kernelspec and session for the editor and executes the current runnable range(s) against the kernel.

nodes.name: install_ipykernel_and_assign
nodes.summary: Installs ipykernel into the selected Python environment when missing, then assigns the resulting kernelspec to the editor's worktree.

nodes.name: setup_editor_session_actions
nodes.summary: Registers the REPL editor actions (run, interrupt, restart, shutdown, clear outputs) on an editor so keybindings dispatch to the active session.

nodes.name: runnable_ranges
nodes.summary: Determines which source ranges in the buffer are runnable, dispatching to jupytext cell or markdown-code-block extraction based on language.

nodes.name: assign_kernelspec
nodes.summary: Assigns a chosen kernel specification to an editor's worktree in the ReplStore and prepares the session for that kernel.

nodes.name: ReplSessionsPage
nodes.summary: Workspace item rendering the REPL sessions page, providing tab content, telemetry labels, and the sessions overview UI.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Registers the REPL editor actions and command-palette entries and wires up global observers when the REPL subsystem starts.

nodes.name: ReplStore
nodes.summary: The global REPL state container tracking sessions, per-worktree kernel specifications and selections, discovered kernelspecs, and the enabled flag, with methods to refresh, select, and shut down kernels and sessions.

nodes.name: refresh_kernelspecs
nodes.summary: Re-discovers all available kernel specifications (local, remote, WSL, Python-env) and updates the store's cached lists.

nodes.name: refresh_python_kernelspecs
nodes.summary: Discovers Python-environment kernelspecs for a worktree and updates the store, tracking in-flight fetches to avoid duplicate work.

nodes.name: active_kernelspec
nodes.summary: Resolves the kernel specification that should be used for a worktree, honoring explicit selections and recommended-kernel fallbacks.

nodes.name: shutdown_all_sessions
nodes.summary: Shuts down every active REPL session, used on subsystem teardown or when the REPL is disabled.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Represents a live REPL session bound to a running kernel and an editor, orchestrating code execution, output routing to editor decorations, stdin replies, and kernel lifecycle (interrupt/restart/shutdown).

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Sends an execute request for a code range to the kernel, creates and places the ExecutionView as an editor block/inlay, and wires message routing for the resulting outputs.

nodes.name: start_kernel
nodes.summary: Launches the kernel for the session according to its KernelSpecification and transitions the session/kernel state as it connects.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Routes an incoming Jupyter message to the correct ExecutionView by matching its parent message id, driving output updates.

nodes.name: replace_block_with_inlay
nodes.summary: Swaps an editor block decoration for an inlay (or vice versa) so small outputs display inline while large ones use block placement.

nodes.name: on_buffer_event
nodes.summary: Reacts to editor buffer edits to keep execution output decorations positioned correctly as the underlying text changes.

nodes.name: action.rs
nodes.summary: Defines serializable settings types for keymap command aliases and action names/arguments, used to parse user keybinding configuration into typed actions.

nodes.name: ActionName
nodes.summary: Serializable identifier for a named action referenced in keymap or command configuration.

nodes.name: CommandAliasTarget
nodes.summary: Represents the target action (or sequence of actions) that a command alias resolves to in user settings.

nodes.name: agent.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for the AI agent panel: model selection, agent servers, auto-compaction thresholds, notification sounds, and per-provider configuration options.

nodes.name: AgentSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct for the AI agent panel, aggregating model provider settings, UI preferences, and agent server configuration as parsed from user settings.json.

nodes.name: AllAgentServersSettings
nodes.summary: Maps configured external agent server names to their individual settings.

nodes.name: editor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for the text editor: gutter, scrollbar, minimap, code lens, line numbers, contrast, and dozens of other per-editor display and behavior options.

nodes.name: EditorSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct for the code editor, aggregating over fifty optional fields controlling editor appearance and behavior as parsed from user settings.json.

nodes.name: CenteredPaddingSettings
nodes.summary: Configures the horizontal padding used when centered-layout mode is enabled in the editor.

nodes.name: extension.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the settings schema for extension configuration, including per-extension enablement and declared capabilities.

nodes.name: ExtensionSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct controlling which extensions are enabled/disabled and their auto-update behavior.

nodes.name: fallible_options.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a wrapper type for settings fields that may fail to parse, capturing the raw value and error so a single malformed setting does not break the entire settings file.

nodes.name: FallibleOption
nodes.summary: Wraps an optional settings value that may fail validation, preserving the parse error for diagnostics while still yielding a usable default.

nodes.name: language.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for language-specific behavior: edit predictions, formatters, inlay hints, language servers, and per-language overrides aggregated under AllLanguageSettingsContent.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large schema file (1500+ lines) with 38 struct/enum definitions modeling per-language settings overrides.

nodes.name: AllLanguageSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct aggregating default language settings plus per-language-name overrides.

nodes.name: FormatterList
nodes.summary: Represents one or more configured code formatters to run for a language, in order.

nodes.name: EditPredictionProvider
nodes.summary: Selects which AI edit-prediction provider (e.g. Zeta, Copilot, Supermaven) is active for a language.

nodes.name: language_model.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for language model provider configuration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and OpenAI-compatible providers), including API keys, model capabilities, and per-provider connection options.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains 46 small struct/enum definitions, one set per supported LLM provider's configuration shape.

nodes.name: AllLanguageModelSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct aggregating per-provider language model configuration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and compatible providers).

nodes.name: OpenAiCompatibleModelCapabilities
nodes.summary: Declares which API capabilities (tool use, images, parallel tool calls, etc.) an OpenAI-compatible custom model supports.

nodes.name: merge_from.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the MergeFrom trait and its implementations used to layer settings sources (default, user, project, local) by merging optional fields from a higher-priority source into a base settings struct.

nodes.name: MergeFrom
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by settings structs to merge a higher-priority settings layer's populated fields on top of a base value.

nodes.name: merge_from
nodes.summary: Default trait method implementing field-by-field merge semantics: Some values from the override layer replace None values in the base.

nodes.name: project.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for project-level configuration: LSP server settings, git integration, semantic token rules, and other project/worktree-scoped options.

nodes.name: ProjectSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct for project-level configuration, aggregating git, LSP, and semantic token settings.

nodes.name: LspSettings
nodes.summary: Per-language-server configuration including initialization options, binary path overrides, and settings passed to the LSP server.

nodes.name: SemanticTokenRule
nodes.summary: Defines a single rule mapping LSP semantic token types/modifiers to editor highlight styling.

nodes.name: serde_helper.rs
nodes.summary: Provides small serde helper functions used across the settings schema for custom (de)serialization behavior, such as treating specific values as defaults or empty.

nodes.name: default_true
nodes.summary: Serde default-value helper returning true, used to give boolean settings fields a true default when absent.

nodes.name: settings_content.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root and top-level aggregation point for the settings schema: declares all settings submodules and defines SettingsContent/UserSettingsContent, the root structs that compose every settings domain (editor, agent, theme, terminal, workspace, etc.) into the full user settings document.
nodes.languageNotes: Barrel-like crate root that both declares submodules and defines the top-level SettingsContent struct combining all domain-specific settings structs (57 types total in this file alone).

nodes.name: SettingsContent
nodes.summary: Top-level settings document struct aggregating every settings domain (editor, agent, project, terminal, theme, workspace, title bar, language, language model) into one deserializable schema.

nodes.name: UserSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Represents the raw structure of a user's settings.json file, including profile-specific overrides layered on top of SettingsContent.

nodes.name: RootUserSettings
nodes.summary: Root wrapper for user settings including feature flags and the base settings content.

nodes.name: terminal.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for the integrated terminal: shell selection, working directory, line height, environment variables, and other terminal display/behavior options.

nodes.name: TerminalSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct for the integrated terminal, aggregating shell, appearance, and working-directory configuration.

nodes.name: Shell
nodes.summary: Configures which shell program and arguments the integrated terminal launches.

nodes.name: WorkingDirectory
nodes.summary: Specifies how the terminal's initial working directory is determined (current project, home, or a fixed path).

nodes.name: theme.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for theming: theme selection, font family/size/weight/features, icon themes, and UI density options.

nodes.name: ThemeSelection
nodes.summary: Represents either a single theme name or a dynamic light/dark theme pair to select based on system appearance.

nodes.name: FontFeaturesContent
nodes.summary: Represents a set of OpenType font feature toggles (e.g. ligatures) configurable per font in settings.

nodes.name: FontWeightContent
nodes.summary: Represents a configurable font weight value for UI or buffer fonts in settings.

nodes.name: title_bar.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for the window title bar: window control button layout and visibility toggles for various title bar items.

nodes.name: TitleBarSettingsContent
nodes.summary: Root settings struct for title bar configuration, controlling which items (menus, branch name, sign-in button, etc.) are shown.

nodes.name: WindowButtonLayoutContent
nodes.summary: Configures the position and visibility of native window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close) in the title bar.

nodes.name: workspace.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the deserializable settings schema for workspace-level behavior: autosave, window-closing behavior, encoding display, semantic tokens, and folding range options.

nodes.name: AutosaveSetting
nodes.summary: Configures whether and how buffers are automatically saved (off, on focus change, on window change, or after a delay).

nodes.name: CloseWindowWhenNoItems
nodes.summary: Controls what happens to a window when its last item/tab is closed (close window, keep open, or platform default).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for GPUI's built-in element library, declaring and re-exporting every core UI primitive (div, text, img, svg, list, uniform_list, etc.) so the framework and downstream crates can compose views from them.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module barrel using `mod` declarations plus glob `pub use` re-exports to flatten the element submodules into the parent namespace.

nodes.name: anchored.rs
nodes.summary: Anchored element that positions its child relative to a point (or the cursor) and flips/snaps it to stay within the window, powering popovers, tooltips, and context menus.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements GPUI's Element trait lifecycle (request_layout/prepaint/paint); fit-mode and position-mode enums drive the overflow-avoidance geometry in prepaint.

nodes.name: animation.rs
nodes.summary: Time-based animation wrapper and the AnimationExt trait, letting any element be driven by an easing curve over a duration with per-frame re-render requests.
nodes.languageNotes: AnimationExt is a blanket extension trait adding `.with_animation()` to all elements; AnimationElement stores a closure that maps animation delta into a transformed child each frame.

nodes.name: canvas.rs
nodes.summary: Escape hatch element that hands the caller a raw paint closure and layout bounds, enabling fully custom immediate-mode drawing within GPUI's retained element tree.

nodes.name: container_query.rs
nodes.summary: Container-query element that measures its own laid-out size and passes it to a builder closure, allowing children to adapt style/content to the available container dimensions (CSS container-query analog).

nodes.name: deferred.rs
nodes.summary: Deferred element that delays painting its child to a later, priority-ordered pass so overlays and popovers can render above sibling content regardless of tree order.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the window's deferred-draw queue with an explicit priority; prepaint registers the child for a later paint pass rather than painting inline.

nodes.name: div.rs
nodes.summary: The foundational GPUI container element and the heart of the framework's interaction model: Div plus the InteractiveElement/StatefulInteractiveElement traits and the Interactivity struct that wire up styling, flexbox layout, mouse/keyboard/action/drag/scroll handling, tooltips, accessibility, and scroll handles for essentially every view in the editor.
nodes.languageNotes: InteractiveElement and StatefulInteractiveElement are large builder traits implemented across many element types; Interactivity centralizes hitbox insertion, listener registration, style computation, and scroll clamping. This ~4700-line file is the single most load-bearing element in GPUI.

nodes.name: image_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Image-cache element and the ImageCache trait hierarchy that scopes decoded-image retention to a subtree, with a RetainAllImageCache implementation and provider indirection for cache lifetime management.

nodes.name: img.rs
nodes.summary: Image element supporting many source types (paths, URLs, bytes, render images, SVG data), object-fit/grayscale styling, animated-frame playback, fallback and loading states, and async decoding through the asset/image-cache system.
nodes.languageNotes: ImageSource is a broad enum with many `From` impls; ImageAssetLoader/ImageDecoder integrate asset loading, and ImageCacheError unifies decode/IO/asset failures via `From` conversions.

nodes.name: list.rs
nodes.summary: Virtualized variable-height list element built on a sum-tree of item heights, with ListState managing measurement, splicing, scroll anchoring, follow-tail mode, and scrollbar interaction for large scrollable collections.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a SumTree with Count/Height summary dimensions for O(log n) item lookup; supports non-uniform item heights, deferred remeasurement, and scroll-anchor-preserving splices — critical for rendering long documents and outputs.

nodes.name: surface.rs
nodes.summary: Surface element that paints a platform-native video/image surface (e.g. decoded video frames) with object-fit sizing inside the GPUI element tree.

nodes.name: svg.rs
nodes.summary: SVG icon element that renders a themed vector asset with an optional affine Transformation (scale/translate/rotate), used pervasively for editor iconography.
nodes.languageNotes: Transformation composes scale/translation/rotation into a matrix applied at paint time; SvgAsset integrates with the asset loader for rasterizing vector paths.

nodes.name: text.rs
nodes.summary: Text rendering elements — plain Text, StyledText with per-range highlights and font overrides, the shared TextLayout that shapes/wraps lines and maps between pixel positions and character indices, and InteractiveText adding click/hover/tooltip regions. Foundational for all typographic UI and directly relevant to the markdown/LaTeX editing roadmap.
nodes.languageNotes: TextLayout caches shaped line layouts and exposes index_for_position/position_for_index for cursor hit-testing; StyledText.compute_runs merges highlight ranges into styled text runs. Central to markdown and LaTeX rendering.

nodes.name: uniform_list.rs
nodes.summary: Virtualized fixed-height list element that renders only visible rows by multiplying a single measured item height, with a scroll handle offering strict/offset scroll-to-item strategies, y-flipping, and decoration overlays.
nodes.languageNotes: Cheaper than List because all items share one height, enabling O(1) index math; UniformListScrollHandle and ScrollStrategy give callers precise programmatic scroll control.

nodes.name: Anchored
nodes.summary: Element that anchors a child to a corner/point with configurable offset, fit mode, and window snapping; its builder methods and Element impl drive overflow-aware overlay positioning.

nodes.name: AnchoredPositionMode
nodes.summary: Enum describing how an anchored element computes its final position (window vs. local), with get_position_and_bounds resolving the concrete bounds.

nodes.name: Animation
nodes.summary: Value object describing an animation's duration, repeat behavior, and easing function, constructed via new/repeat/with_easing builders.

nodes.name: AnimationExt
nodes.summary: Blanket extension trait adding with_animation/with_animations to any element so it can be driven by an Animation and a per-frame mapping closure.

nodes.name: Canvas
nodes.summary: Element wrapping a prepaint and paint closure to expose raw, immediate-mode drawing against computed layout bounds.

nodes.name: ContainerQuery
nodes.summary: Element that resolves its own laid-out size and invokes a builder with those dimensions so children can respond to the container's size.

nodes.name: Deferred
nodes.summary: Element that queues its child for a later, priority-ordered paint pass to control z-ordering of overlays independent of tree position.

nodes.name: Div
nodes.summary: The primary GPUI container element: holds child elements, a Style, and an Interactivity, and implements the full Element lifecycle (request_layout/prepaint/paint) including image-cache scoping, accessibility info, and dynamic prepaint ordering.

nodes.name: InteractiveElement
nodes.summary: Large builder trait exposing the mouse, keyboard, action, drag, scroll, hover, tooltip, focus, and grouping handlers that any interactive element gains by delegating to its Interactivity.

nodes.name: StatefulInteractiveElement
nodes.summary: Extension trait for identified (stateful) elements adding ARIA accessibility attributes, scroll tracking/anchoring, active/hover styling, click/aux-click, drag source, and stateful tooltip handlers.

nodes.name: Interactivity
nodes.summary: Central state struct backing all interactive elements: stores registered listeners and style refinements and performs hitbox insertion, style computation, scroll clamping, mouse/keyboard/scroll listener painting, tooltip management, and accessibility emission.

nodes.name: ScrollHandle
nodes.summary: Handle giving programmatic access to a scrollable Div's offset and item bounds, with helpers to scroll to specific items, top/bottom, or an active item and query logical scroll extents.

nodes.name: ScrollAnchor
nodes.summary: Anchors a scroll handle to a stable reference item so content can be spliced without visually jumping the viewport.

nodes.name: RetainAllImageCache
nodes.summary: ImageCache implementation that retains every loaded image for a subtree's lifetime, exposing load/clear/remove/len for explicit cache management.

nodes.name: ImageCacheElement
nodes.summary: Element that installs an image cache into the window context for its child subtree, scoping decoded-image retention to that region of the tree.

nodes.name: ImageSource
nodes.summary: Enum unifying the many ways an image can be supplied (file path, URL, raw bytes, render image, SVG, asset), with numerous From conversions and data-access/eviction helpers.

nodes.name: Img
nodes.summary: Image element implementing the Element lifecycle: resolves its source, decodes asynchronously through the image cache, applies object-fit/grayscale styling, and plays animated frames with fallback/loading states.

nodes.name: StyledImage
nodes.summary: Trait providing image styling builders (grayscale, object_fit, fallback, loading) shared by image-bearing elements.

nodes.name: ImageCacheError
nodes.summary: Unified error enum for image loading covering decode, IO, and asset failures, with From conversions from the underlying error types.

nodes.name: List
nodes.summary: Virtualized variable-height list element that renders only visible items from a ListState, honoring a configurable sizing behavior.

nodes.name: ListState
nodes.summary: Shared, cloneable state for a virtualized list: measures item heights, splices items while preserving scroll anchors, tracks follow-tail mode and scrollbar dragging, and answers viewport/scroll queries.

nodes.name: StateInner
nodes.summary: Internal list state holding the SumTree of item heights and scroll bookkeeping; performs layout, prepaint, scroll resolution, and pending-scroll rebasing across item splices.

nodes.name: Surface
nodes.summary: Element that paints a native video/image surface with configurable object-fit sizing inside the GPUI tree.

nodes.name: Svg
nodes.summary: SVG element rendering a themed vector asset (from a bundled or external path) with an optional affine transformation applied at paint time.

nodes.name: Transformation
nodes.summary: Composable 2D transform (scale/translate/rotate) that resolves into a matrix for transforming SVG rendering.

nodes.name: Text
nodes.summary: Simple text element wrapping a SharedString with optional element id and accessibility role, implementing the Element lifecycle to shape and paint a run of text.

nodes.name: StyledText
nodes.summary: Text element supporting per-range highlight styling and font-family overrides, merging highlight ranges into styled text runs before layout.

nodes.name: TextLayout
nodes.summary: Shared, cached line-layout for text: shapes and wraps lines, then maps between pixel positions and character indices for cursor hit-testing, line queries, and bounds — central to interactive text and editor cursor placement.

nodes.name: InteractiveText
nodes.summary: Wraps StyledText with click, hover, and tooltip regions keyed by character ranges, enabling clickable links and hoverable spans within rendered text.

nodes.name: UniformList
nodes.summary: Virtualized fixed-height list element that renders only visible rows, supporting width-from-item sizing, horizontal sizing behavior, decorations, y-flipping, and scroll tracking.

nodes.name: UniformListScrollHandle
nodes.summary: Handle for programmatically scrolling a uniform list to specific items with strict/offset strategies, plus y-flip, scroll-to-bottom, and scroll-state queries.

nodes.name: UniformListDecoration
nodes.summary: Trait for drawing decorations (e.g. indent guides, dividers) over a uniform list's visible range, given the computed item layout.

nodes.name: color_space.rs
nodes.summary: Color space conversion utilities that translate between HSLA, Oklab, and Oklch representations, used for perceptually uniform theme color manipulation.

nodes.name: Oklab
nodes.summary: Struct representing a color in the Oklab perceptual color space with lightness, a, and b components.

nodes.name: Oklch
nodes.summary: Struct representing a color in the Oklch cylindrical color space with lightness, chroma, and hue components.

nodes.name: oklch_to_hsla
nodes.summary: Converts an Oklch color plus alpha back into an HSLA color, clamping RGB components into valid range.

nodes.name: default_colors.rs
nodes.summary: Generated color palette data providing the default light/dark neutral scales and the full Radix-style color scale set (gray, tomato, blue, etc.) used to build themes.
nodes.languageNotes: Almost entirely auto-generated tabular color constant data; each named function returns a fixed ColorScale for one palette.

nodes.name: light
nodes.summary: Builds the default light-mode neutral color scale used as a base for fallback and generated themes.

nodes.name: dark
nodes.summary: Builds the default dark-mode neutral color scale used as a base for fallback and generated themes.

nodes.name: default_color_scales
nodes.summary: Assembles the full ColorScales struct by combining every individual named palette function (gray, mauve, tomato, etc.).

nodes.name: StaticColorScaleSet
nodes.summary: Struct holding the static light/dark and alpha-variant color arrays for a single named palette scale.

nodes.name: fallback_themes.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in fallback theme family (Zed Default Dark/Light) used when no extension theme is loaded, including default status and player colors.

nodes.name: zed_default_themes
nodes.summary: Returns the built-in ThemeFamily containing the default dark and light themes shipped with the app.

nodes.name: apply_status_color_defaults
nodes.summary: Fills in any unset status colors (error, warning, success, etc.) on a theme with sensible defaults.

nodes.name: apply_theme_color_defaults
nodes.summary: Fills in unset theme and player colors on a theme using computed defaults derived from existing theme colors.

nodes.name: zed_default_dark
nodes.summary: Constructs the complete default dark theme, specifying every UI, syntax, and status color used when no user theme overrides them.

nodes.name: font_family_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Global cache that asynchronously prefetches and stores the list of installed system font families for use in theme/font settings UI.

nodes.name: FontFamilyCache
nodes.summary: Global singleton exposing methods to list and prefetch available system font families, backed by an async-loaded cache state.

nodes.name: list_font_families
nodes.summary: Returns the currently cached list of font families, triggering a background prefetch if not yet loaded.

nodes.name: prefetch
nodes.summary: Asynchronously loads the system font family list via the platform text system and populates the cache state.

nodes.name: icon_theme.rs
nodes.summary: Runtime data model for icon themes, describing directory/chevron/file icon associations resolved from an icon theme family definition.

nodes.name: IconThemeFamily
nodes.summary: Represents a family of icon themes (e.g., light/dark variants) sharing an id, name, and author.

nodes.name: IconTheme
nodes.summary: A single resolved icon theme with directory, chevron, and file-type icon mappings keyed by stem/suffix.

nodes.name: icon_keys_by_association
nodes.summary: Groups icon definition keys by their icon association for lookup during file/directory icon resolution.

nodes.name: icon_theme_schema.rs
nodes.summary: Serde-deserializable schema structs mirroring the on-disk JSON format for icon theme definitions, prior to conversion into runtime IconTheme types.

nodes.name: IconThemeContent
nodes.summary: Deserialized on-disk representation of a single icon theme's icon mappings before conversion to the runtime IconTheme.

nodes.name: registry.rs
nodes.summary: Global ThemeRegistry that stores, loads, and looks up all available themes and icon themes, including loading icon theme families from extension assets.

nodes.name: ThemeRegistry
nodes.summary: Central global registry providing CRUD-like operations over installed themes and icon themes, and resolving icon theme assets on disk.

nodes.name: load_icon_theme
nodes.summary: Loads an IconThemeFamily's icon definitions from disk into runtime IconTheme structs, resolving relative icon paths against the icons root directory.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Lists metadata (name and appearance) for all registered themes, optionally filtered by staff status.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Looks up a registered theme by name, returning an error if not found.

nodes.name: scale.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ColorScale and ColorScaleSet types representing a 12-step color ramp (Radix-style), plus accessors for individual scale steps and light/dark/alpha variants.

nodes.name: ColorScale
nodes.summary: A 12-step ordered array of colors representing one Radix-style color ramp, with indexed step accessors.
